jobs.title: Telehealth Registered Dietitian
jobs.excerpt: Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting.
jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting. This is a PRN (as-needed) role requiring a minimum of 12 hours of weekly availability, with the opportunity to offer additional hours if desired. The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind-one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role Details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Schedule: PRN / flexible with consistent weekly availability
  • Compensation: $54 to $59 hourly

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for

We’re seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Minimum of 12 hours of weekly availability required, with flexibility and opportunity to increase hours over time based on your preferences and schedule
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care
  • Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans
  • Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner
  • Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes
  • Maintain a minimum of 12 hours of weekly availability, with opportunity to grow into a higher-hour or full-time schedule

What to Expect
At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set your availability with the ability to build and adjust your schedule based on your preferences and patient demand
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript. Commissions are paid quarterly and can meaningfully increase your overall earnings based on patient engagement.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Accrue 1 hour of PTO for every 12 hours of patient care, supporting flexibility and time away as you work.
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s — guaranteed time off from patient appointments & administrative work
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff AI Security Engineer, Threat Hunting

About the job

The Threat Detection and Response team is looking for a Senior Security Engineer who is passionate about solving the business’s toughest technical-security challenges; you will work within a Security Engineering team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions. You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security tooling, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be an Owner: Participate in daily operations tasks including, on-call rotation, architecting and developing well-engineered and performant detective tooling and automation, participating in applications/systems threat modeling, and participating in Incident Response activities
  • Write It Down: Work with the team to align the Detection and Response vision and strategy, while engaging the team to develop and ship specific, multi-year roadmaps, programs, and projects, ensuring prioritization, resourcing, and timely delivery of work within a changing business environment
  • Wear the customer’s shoes: Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity
  • Ruthlessly Prioritize: Proactively identify areas that would most benefit the improvement of our business, inclusive of the Incident Response program and with consideration of company/organizational objectives
  • Don’t Settle: Challenge the status quo; perform technology research, security research, and architecture reviews needed for a thorough understanding of the Twilio platform to understand what we are defending and how best to defend it
  • Draw the Owl: Building systems and services to make the most complex security problems simple and frictionless
  • Empower Others: Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work
  • Be Inclusive: Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale

About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

In-person experiences are becoming an increasingly important part of how Engine connects with prospects and customers. We’re looking for a highly organized, hands-on Senior Events Specialist who can help us execute a growing portfolio of events while keeping the business outcome in view. This is not a role for someone who only plans a great-looking booth. You’ll own the details that make events run smoothly, partner closely with Growth, Sales, Marketing Operations, Brand, Supply and Partnerships, and help ensure the work before and after an event supports pipeline and measurable event impact.

Your Mission

You’ll join at an important moment for the Events team: the organization is increasing its investment in in-person and experiential marketing, the foundation for execution is already in place, and the team is preparing for a significantly larger event calendar. You should be comfortable getting into the details, moving quickly across multiple events at once, and being the person who makes sure teams are truly set up for success on the ground.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-End Event Execution: Support the full event lifecycle from business case and approvals through logistics, on-site execution, teardown, post-event reporting, and follow-up.
  • Event Logistics & Production: Coordinate booth setup, venue and vendor needs, A/V, Wi-Fi, lead scanners, shipping, print materials, signage, swag, food and beverage, rentals, and other details required to execute successfully.
  • Project Management: Build and maintain detailed project plans, task lists, timelines, and stakeholder updates in Asana so multiple events can move forward at the same time without details slipping through the cracks.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales, Marketing Operations, Brand, Supply, Partnerships, and Growth to understand the business objective for each event and translate it into a clear execution plan.
  • Marketing Operations & Lead Management: Partner with GTM systems and Marketing Operations to support Salesforce campaign setup, attendee and lead-list uploads, routing, data hygiene, enrichment, and the pre- and post-event workflows that enable follow-up.
  • Pre- and Post-Event Activation: Help ensure the right teams are completing outreach before events and that leads, opportunities, feedback, and follow-up are captured after events. For us, an event is not finished when the booth comes down.
  • Event Measurement: Support event reporting, feedback collection, and ROI evaluation so the team can understand performance, identify opportunities, and inform future event decisions.
  • On-Site Ownership: Travel to priority Tier 1 and Tier 2 events and provide hands-on support with setup, breakdown, attendee flow, booth readiness, and whatever else is needed to execute well.
  • High-Volume Execution: Stay organized across a fast-moving calendar that can include 5-7 events in a week, with events at different stages of planning and execution.

What You’ll Bring to Engine

  • 3+ years of experience in event marketing, event operations, field/event coordination, or a similar role with meaningful ownership of detailed logistics.
  • A marketer’s mindset: you understand that events are a demand-generation channel and can connect execution to lead follow-up, pipeline, ROI, and business outcomes—not just the on-site experience.
  • Hands-on execution experience. You are comfortable doing the work yourself—from coordinating vendors and materials to booth setup and teardown—rather than relying on outside planners for every detail.
  • Experience managing multiple events or complex projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment; high-volume event experience is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working in Salesforce or another CRM, including event campaigns, lead/attendee lists, routing, data hygiene, and follow-up workflows.
  • Strong Asana proficiency and the ability to create clear, scalable project plans and workflows.
  • Experience coordinating vendors, sourcing and scheduling deliverables, tracking budgets/expenses, and managing event materials, swag, print, and fulfillment.
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep cross-functional partners aligned.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and event requests may come together quickly.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% for priority events and work occasional evenings or weekends as needed.

Nice to Have

  • B2B trade show, conference, sponsorship, or exhibitor experience.
  • Experience supporting sales-driven, growth, or demand-generation events.
  • Experience with gifting or fulfillment platforms such as Sendoso, Reachdesk, or similar.
  • Swag and print-production coordination experience.
  • Hospitality or travel industry experience.
  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

The analysis is only half the role: the other half is that someone changes what they do because of what you found.

You will work close to the growth function at an early-stage company, which means the questions are open rather than assigned. Expect to spend time in spreadsheets, to have to define a metric before you can report it, and to write up what you learned so it survives past the week you learned it.

  • Build and maintain simple reporting that the team actually reads and uses.
  • Define and document metrics so numbers mean the same thing week to week.

Requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns in data.

  • Organized and comfortable working across several projects at once.

It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

You will build and lead a team of Partner Account Managers responsible for sourcing new Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partnerships and managing and growing our existing portfolio of ISV partners with payments use cases. You’ll operate as both strategist and operational leader — setting the vision for how 8am’s payments partner ecosystem expands in scope and value, while building the day-to-day discipline, processes, and accountability that turn that vision into measurable results.

This is a leadership role with high visibility across 8am’s Partnerships, Product, and Sales organizations. You’ll be accountable for your team’s book of ISV relationships, the roadmap of new functionality and payment types brought to those partners, and the rigor with which your team manages pipeline, renewals, and partner health. While the relationships you and your team manage are business-to-business, you’ll keep the shared end customer — the businesses and consumers who ultimately experience these payment capabilities — at the center of every decision.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Partner Account Managers — responsible for sourcing new ISV partnerships and managing and growing the existing portfolio of ISV partners with payments use cases.
  • Own the strategic roadmap for 8am’s ISV and payments partner ecosystem — identifying which partners, integrations, and payment types will drive the greatest shared growth for 8am and our partners alike.
  • Champion partner growth and success as a direct lever for 8am’s growth — building the programs, incentives, and enablement that help ISV partners succeed with payments, and in turn grow with 8am.
  • Prioritize and drive new functionality and payment types — new payment methods, embedded capabilities, and value-added services — that create tangible value for partners and the shared end customers they serve.
  • Set and manage team KPIs, scorecards, and an operating cadence — covering pipeline health, partner satisfaction, revenue growth, and integration or launch velocity.
  • Establish and run a consistent partner engagement model — QBRs, escalation paths, and executive-level relationship-building with 8am’s most strategic ISV partners.
  • Lead commercial strategy for the ISV portfolio — pricing, incentive structures, renewals, and negotiation support for your team’s largest and most strategic partnerships.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Risk, and Compliance — to ensure new payment capabilities and partner integrations ship successfully and on plan.
  • Maintain a B2B-with-a-C-in-mind mindset — ensuring that even purely business-to-business partnership decisions are evaluated for their impact on the end consumer and customer experience.
  • Coach, mentor, and grow a high-performing team — building a strong talent bench and a culture of accountability, curiosity, and customer-centricity.
  • Represent 8am externally — as an executive-level point of contact for top ISV partners.

About you:

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or partner/account management within payments, fintech, or SaaS — including significant experience with ISV or software partner ecosystems.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, having built, managed, and developed teams of partner account managers or a similar partner-facing function.
  • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — acquiring/processing, payment methods, embedded payments, and the economics underpinning ISV and software partner models.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as both strategist and operator — equally comfortable setting multi-year partner strategy and rolling up your sleeves on day-to-day team execution.
  • Proven track record of driving partner growth (revenue, adoption, retention) through structured account management and commercial negotiation.
  • Experience prioritizing and launching new product functionality or payment types in partnership with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong commercial and analytical instincts — comfortable with partner economics, KPIs, and data-driven prioritization.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and cross-functional influence skills, with a track record of developing high-performing teams.
  • A genuine customer-centric mindset — able to translate business-to-business partnership decisions into better outcomes for the end customer.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong executive presence.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; MBA a plus.
  • Willingness to travel periodically (~20%) for partner and team engagements, on-sites, and industry events.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Additional InformationThe annual salary range for this position is $180,000 to $220,000. The salary range for performing this role outside of the US / Austin / California may differ. 8am is committed to offering competitive, fair and commensurate compensation and has provided an estimated pay range for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and education.
Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

  • Health Insurance Coverage: We offer our 8Team a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit your needs, including a 100% company-paid HDHP plan for employees.
  • Financial perks: We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including annual bonuses, equity options and 401(k) or RRSP if in Canada, with a company match for all team members.
  • Time for what matters: Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, and a parental leave program for our new parents.
  • Wellness: Wellness stipends, mental health support, and one-on-one nutrition coaching.
  • Learning and Development: Continuous learning through , leadership programs, professional development funds, and individually focused talent development.
  • Giving back to the communities around us: Participate in our charitable matching gift program, paid time off for volunteer service, and company-sponsored volunteer events (both local and virtually).
  • Engagement: Virtual and in-person team-building events, quarterly award recognition through our Rise & Shine Award of Excellence Program, and our peer-to-peer appreciation platform.

At 8am, we don’t just offer benefits - we create an environment where people can thrive, grow, and make a real impact every day.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. Senior Manager, Clinical Data Management

The Senior Manager, Clinical Data Management will lead and contribute to data management activities in support of Alnylam studies across all stages of clinical drug development. This position reports to the Director, Clinical Data Management or Associate Director, Clinical Data Management.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

  • Function as program level data management lead in support of Alnylam clinical studies, operating both as an individual contributor and manager of direct reports;
  • Lead oversight of database build activities, including cross-functional review of eCRF content, review of edit check specifications, and performance of user acceptance testing
  • Monitor data collection, cleaning and coding by CROs via the execution of internal data review plans and review of all vendor data management documentation; provide oversight of all study database lock activities;
  • Participate in the drafting and/or review of timelines consistent with company goals and ensure all deliverables and milestones are met;
  • Provide strategic guidance to direct reports and internal cross-functional team members regarding data management activities in support of database locks, regulatory submissions and/or other key study deliverables
  • Train, mentor and oversee work activities of direct reports; provide regular performance review assessments
  • Author and contribute to development and implementation of departmental standards and infrastructure strategy, such as SOPs, data collection standards and document templates, consistent with industry best practices;
  • Support GCP inspection readiness and participate as subject matter expert in GCP inspections;
  • Represent data management and effectively communicate requirements, strategy, timelines and deliverables at internal cross-functional team meetings and meetings with external vendors;
  • Collaborate effectively with internal and external partners, including Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, Clinical Research, Quality Assurance, Global Patient Safety and Risk Management and Regulatory Affairs; CROs, central laboratories, and other vendors;
  • Review clinical protocols/amendments, clinical study reports, etc.;
  • Demonstrate clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including Commitment to People, Innovation and Discovery, Sense of Urgency, Open Culture and Passion for Excellence

Qualifications

  • BS/BA in scientific discipline, MS or equivalent preferred
  • At least 10 years related experience in a pharmaceutical/biologics/biotechnology company;
  • Extensive experience managing global studies through Phase 3 in an outsourced CRO model from start-up through close-out; experience with drug development in rare genetic diseases preferred;
  • Experience managing direct reports and providing performance reviews and career development guidance;
  • Experience developing Data Management SOPs and standards;
  • Understanding of ICH GCP as well as general knowledge of industry practices and standards;
  • Knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements and expectations for clinical data systems including 21 CFR Part 11;
  • Expert knowledge of eClinical processes, efficient design/build of an EDC data management system and other Clinical Trial data/Data Management Systems;
  • Expert knowledge and understanding of regulations and industry-adopted data standards, such as CDISC-SDTM and CDASH;
  • Experience using standardized medical terminology, including MedDRA and WHODrug;
  • Experience working with Medidata Rave EDC system;
  • Experience working with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint), familiarity with MS Project;
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills;
  • Highly motivated and flexible, with excellent organizational skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team
  • NDA/MAA submission experience preferred;

$144,500.00 - $195,500.00

This partner-facing role will help accelerate solution adoption across the NiCE portfolio by enabling GSI sales, presales and delivery teams, supporting active opportunities, shaping compelling customer solution narratives and ensuring partners can confidently position, demonstrate and deploy NiCE solutions.

Customer Service Representative (CSR) – Remote | U.S. Business Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to provide fast, professional, and empathetic customer support across phone, email, live chat, and support ticket platforms.

You’ll serve as the frontline voice of the business, helping customers resolve issues, answering questions, documenting interactions, and ensuring every customer receives a positive and professional experience.

This is a high-volume, customer-facing role where communication, responsiveness, problem-solving, and follow-through are essential.

If you enjoy helping people, communicate confidently, and stay calm and organized in fast-paced environments, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

Handle inbound customer inquiries across:

  • Phone
  • Email
  • Live chat
  • Support tickets

You’ll:

  • Respond quickly and professionally to customer questions
  • Understand customer concerns and identify the appropriate solution
  • Troubleshoot common issues
  • Resolve requests whenever possible on the first interaction
  • Escalate complex cases to the appropriate team
  • Follow unresolved issues through completion
  • Maintain a professional and empathetic customer experience

Ticket & Case Management

Manage customer requests using support platforms such as:

  • Zendesk
  • Freshdesk
  • Help Scout
  • Salesforce Service Cloud

You’ll:

  • Create and update support tickets
  • Prioritize cases based on urgency and SLA requirements
  • Maintain accurate case notes and documentation
  • Track outstanding issues and next steps
  • Follow up consistently until cases are resolved
  • Keep support queues organized and up to date

Customer Communication & De-Escalation

Provide clear, professional communication throughout the customer journey.

You’ll:

  • Explain solutions in simple, easy-to-understand language
  • Keep customers informed about progress and next steps
  • Handle frustrated customers calmly and professionally
  • De-escalate difficult situations when necessary
  • Set realistic expectations around resolution timelines
  • Maintain a customer-first approach without sacrificing accuracy or process

Knowledge Base & Process Support

Help improve the overall customer support experience.

You’ll:

  • Update FAQs and support documentation
  • Improve response templates and support macros
  • Document recurring customer questions
  • Identify common support issues and trends
  • Share customer feedback with relevant internal teams
  • Recommend improvements that reduce repeat issues

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with teams such as:

  • Operations
  • Billing
  • Product
  • Technical Support
  • Customer Success

You’ll:

  • Escalate issues with complete and accurate context
  • Coordinate internal follow-ups
  • Track cases requiring support from other departments
  • Ensure smooth handoffs between teams
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the process

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Genuinely enjoy helping customers
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Stay calm when dealing with frustrated customers
  • Can manage multiple conversations and tickets simultaneously
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Take ownership instead of passing problems along
  • Follow up consistently until issues are resolved
  • Can balance speed with service quality
  • Work effectively without constant supervision

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Customer service
    • Customer support
    • Call center operations
    • Client-facing roles
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Experience using customer support or ticketing platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
    • Help Scout
  • Comfortable handling high-volume customer inquiries
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational abilities
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers
  • Experience in KPI or SLA-driven customer support environments
  • Familiarity with live chat and support automation tools
  • Multilingual communication skills
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Healthcare
    • Finance
    • Professional or home services
  • Experience handling billing or account-related inquiries

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might:

  • Review and prioritize incoming tickets
  • Answer inbound customer calls
  • Respond to emails and live chats
  • Troubleshoot customer concerns
  • Document interactions in the support system
  • Follow up on unresolved cases
  • Coordinate escalations with internal teams
  • De-escalate frustrated customers
  • Review SLA deadlines and outstanding tickets
  • Identify recurring customer issues
  • Update FAQs or support documentation

In short: You ensure customers receive fast, professional, accurate, and solutions-focused support from their first interaction through final resolution.

Key Metrics for Success

  • First Contact Resolution (FCR)
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS), where applicable
  • Average response time
  • Average resolution time
  • SLA compliance
  • Ticket documentation accuracy
  • Queue management and productivity
  • Escalation quality
  • Customer follow-through and issue resolution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on customer satisfaction and retention
  • High ownership over the customer experience
  • Exposure to modern support and ticketing platforms
  • Opportunity to strengthen communication and problem-solving skills
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Clear growth opportunities into:

    • Customer Support Team Lead
    • Customer Success
    • Client Experience

Interview Process

  2. Spark Hire Intro Video

Apply Now

If you:

  • Enjoy helping customers solve problems
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Can handle high-volume support without sacrificing quality
  • Stay calm and solutions-focused under pressure
  • Take ownership and follow through until issues are resolved

This is a strong opportunity to build your career in customer service while supporting a growing U.S.-based business.

jobs.excerpt: About UsInStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it.
jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Marketing Operations to lead the systems, data, and automation behind how families and referring providers find us and move through our application process. This role connects our marketing, sales, payor, and clinical operations teams so each can see the same picture and act on it quickly. It has one direct report and is fully remote.

Day to day, you will manage our CRM and the marketing tools around it, and serve as the bridge between what our commercial teams need and what product, data science, and engineering build. AI is central to how this work scales: we want someone who will use it to build audiences, spot campaign opportunities, and get useful information in front of the people who can act on it.

The first priority will be strengthening the CRM foundation that everything else depends on. We are looking for a strong strategic thinker who can set direction across our marketing systems and still work hands-on inside them.

Responsibilities:

  • Govern our CRM and the marketing tools connected to it: data model, automation, permissions, and data quality, and keep it reliably connected to our website, analytics tools, and clinical systems.
  • Set strategy and priorities and drive execution with the partner teams that rely on the CRM and other marketing tools, including Marketing, Territory Management (sales), Product, Admissions Team, Clinical Operations, Data Science, Analytics and others.
  • Manage and develop our CRM Administrator, moving that role from handling incoming requests toward a set of strategic priorities.
  • Define how we follow a family or provider from first contact through application, evaluation, and enrollment, and work with data science and analytics on lead scoring, routing, and attribution.
  • Represent commercial and marketing needs in product and engineering planning, so systems work is scoped against the road map and partners know what matters most and why.
  • Build and maintain the audiences our marketing and sales teams rely on, and use AI to surface campaign opportunities such as underserved territories, newly expanded plan coverage, or points where applications stall.
  • Design how marketing-generated provider interest reaches our territory managers (the sales team selling into pediatricians, schools, and other referring partners) with clear targeting, priorities, and automation of the steps that move by hand today.
  • Provide the payor team with the reporting they need to negotiate and expand, including utilization, geographic coverage, and referral volume by plan.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • 5+ years in CRM systems management OR marketing/revenue operations, including hands-on work rebuilding or significantly restructuring a CRM rather than only administering one.
  • Hands-on Zoho CRM experience is preferred; we will also consider candidates with equally deep HubSpot or Salesforce experience who are ready to go deep on Zoho.
  • Proven experience directly managing people, including hiring, developing, and holding a direct report or team accountable to clear priorities.
  • A track record of supporting a sales team with measurable gains in their efficiency and output.
  • Real experience using AI and automation to build things that work, rather than only experimenting with tools.
  • Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move between marketing strategy, how systems are built, and how data flows between them.
  • Comfort with funnel and conversion analytics, and familiarity with how websites capture leads and track behavior (forms, GA4, Segment, or similar).
  • Strong collaboration skills, high attention to detail, and a problem-solving mindset in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or other HIPAA-regulated environments is a plus but not required.

Salary

The expected annual base salary for this role is between $134,000-$149,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, etc.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

Programs You Will Represent

  • SAP module training led by experienced instructors, with structured learning and SAP system practice where included in the selected program.
  • SAP Project Experience Program featuring realistic implementation activities, project documentation, business-process understanding, testing, UAT exposure, and interview preparation.
  • Combined training and project pathways for candidates who need both foundational learning and practical project exposure.
  • Career-support services connected to program completion and internal performance requirements; candidates must never be promised guaranteed employment or placement.

  • Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to explain technical career programs in clear, simple language.
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, email, WhatsApp, and video-meeting tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling SAP, IT, ERP, software, certification, career-development, or professional-training programs.
  • Basic awareness of SAP modules such as FICO, MM, SD, SuccessFactors, Basis, PP, PM, ABAP, or related areas.
  • Experience serving Canadian or U.S. customers and working across time zones.

Performance Measures

  • Response time to new leads and percentage of leads contacted.
  • Number of completed consultations and qualified opportunities.
  • Follow-up completion, CRM accuracy, and lead-pipeline quality.
  • Consultation-to-enrollment conversion rate and monthly enrollment achievement.
  • Communication quality, compliance with program representations, and candidate handoff quality.

What We Offer

  • Remote work opportunity with exposure to international SAP career markets.
  • Competitive compensation based on relevant experience and agreed performance expectations.
  • Training on SAP program offerings, candidate qualification, consultation standards, and internal processes.
  • Professional-development opportunities in educational sales, SAP career pathways, and international lead management.

Job Purpose:

Provide integrated support to patients and physicians by providing a hands-on approach to improve the quality of patient care. Job Duties:

The Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacist (ACP) will help advance quality pharmacotherapy care by actively assuring the provision of safe, efficacious, and cost-effective drug therapy. The ACP collaborates closely with the hybrid ACP team to maximize full suite of therapy management (TM) clinical services within supported clinics. The pharmacist performs in-person and/or virtual/phone assessments on disease state management and drug therapy education stratified based on medication risk level and approved clinic protocol. ACP role will focus to identify, resolve, and prevent medication-related problems. Additional services will also be offered to overcome identified barriers to medication compliance and any other obstacle related to adherence.

SUMMARY:

  • Provide medication management for individuals, including medication reconciliation, dose modification and/or optimization, ordering laboratory tests and medication adherence counseling within the stated parameters of the approved protocol/CPA/CDTM.
  • Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team to develop individualized care plans that align with evidence-based guidelines and best practices for therapy management.
  • Monitor and evaluate medication regimens to ensure clinical criteria are met, including therapeutic goals, adverse effects, and drug interactions.
  • Identify opportunities for drug therapy optimization and provide recommendations for medication cost savings initiatives when applicable.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives by actively participating in clinical outcome studies, REMs compliance/reporting, and ACP-related process improvement projects.
  • Optimize resources and workflows with supporting roles handling complex prior authorizations/appeals by providing clinical justification for medication approval, including supporting literature and rationale.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, including assigned clinic physicians, specialists, and onsite clinic pharmacists, to ensure seamless medication management and coordination of care.
  • Support occasional peer-to-peer requests upon demand.
  • Perform clinical assessments/educational counseling at drug-level for all patients within high priority clinics on qualified on a targeted medication(s).
  • Ensure all clinical criteria is in clinical compliance with guidance from FDA, clinical guidelines, and appropriate evidence-based literature.
  • Assist with workflow optimization initiatives, including identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality of care.
  • Collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to identify operational changes and recommend strategies that enhance productivity, quality, and standards of excellence.
  • Advocate for and promote patient safety and medication literacy through patient education and counseling.
  • Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential.
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations to promote new line of services.
  • Attend and participate in team meetings, conferences, and other professional development activities to stay abreast of current clinical practices and emerging trends.

    • Have provided clinical services to patients for at least one year under a collaborative practice agreement or protocol with a physician, advanced practice pharmacist, pharmacist practicing collaborative drug therapy management, hospital pharmacy practice or health system

Additional Training/Competency:

Skills: Ability to analyze information, exercise good judgment, possess strong verbal communication skills, have deep knowledge of pharmacology developments and FDA health regulations. Ability to manage processes, exhibit strong technical and clinical skills, maintain constant focus on legal compliance, while being highly productive with a focus on quality and
details. Strong clinical knowledge and validated expertise with focus on disease state. management and treatment guidelines.

Other: Energetic, highly motivated, team player with strong personal and communication skills; discretion and confidentiality essential as position deals with highly sensitive and private data.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Enterprise Integration Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Enterprise Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • 8+ years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive - EU Public Sector & NATO
jobs.excerpt: 🌍We’re making security suck less for developers & CISOs Security tools interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck.
jobs.description:
🌍We’re making security suck less for developers & CISOs
Security tools interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck. Aikido builds developer-first products that cut real risk without getting in the way of shipping. Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, with $85M in the bank.

Aikido Strategic & Defense (ASD), our public sector and defense unit, is hiring its first Business Development Executive (EU Public Sector, Defense & NATO). This is a zero-to-one, quota-carrying mandate: you drive and close out our first revenue in the region, then turn those wins into a repeatable motion.

You will be measured on closed revenue first. Strategy, positioning, and partner work exist because they are how deals close here, not as a substitute for closing them. A team comes later, once the number is proven. This is a cyber-first role: developer tooling experience helps, but it is not what earns credibility in an MoD cyber unit.

Who You Will Sell To:
Government and defense institutions themselves, not the defense industrial base: ministries of defense, national cyber commands and CERTs, public agencies, and NATO bodies like the NCI Agency. Three profiles, three entry points:

  • In-house developers: The Aikido core platform, mapped to sovereign and mission outcomes.

  • Few developers, GSI delivery team: Core platform plus supply chain security, sold through the integrator shipping the code.

  • MoD and national cyber units: Autonomous pentesting, Box, and the offensive portfolio alongside defensive coverage. Cyber risk buyers, not engineering buyers.

Requirements

  • Drive and Close Out Our First Revenue: Carry the number and own the full cycle, from first touch through security review and procurement to signature. You source your pipeline and close it.

  • Localize the ASD Strategy: Turn our global strategy into EU positioning and account plans that hold up with sovereign buyers.

  • Define Joint GTM With Partners: Build go-to-market plans with GSIs, regional partners, and distributors holding government frameworks, and hold them accountable for pipeline.

  • Navigate Public Procurement: Lead tenders, RFPs, and RFIs, and build the executive relationships behind them, from CISOs and national cyber leadership to procurement directors. Forecast accurately in HubSpot.

  • Be Part of the Conversation: Operate inside the circles where European defense and cyber decisions get shaped. Credibility here is a deliverable, not a nice-to-have. What

We Are Looking For:

  • Cybersecurity Depth First: Credible on both sides of the house, AppSec and supply chain on defense, pentesting and adversary tradecraft on offense, with a view on how AI is reshaping both.

  • You Speak Acronym: Fluent in the language of this customer base and alive to the nuances here: budget and program cycles, classification boundaries, competing coalition and national interests, and when a slow process means caution, not disinterest.

  • A Closer, Not Just an Opener: 8 to 12 years selling cybersecurity into the EU public sector, defense, or NATO, with a personally attributable record of closing 6- and 7-figure deals. Deep knowledge of government purchasing frameworks and partner-led models. A Network You Can Use Day One: Relationships across European MoDs, national cyber agencies, NATO bodies, or the partners serving them.

  • Clearance, Languages, Location: Eligibility to obtain EU/NATO clearance; an active clearance is not required. Fluent English, with French, German, or Dutch a major plus. Based in Europe near government hubs, Brussels preferred.

Why This Matters to Us
These institutions protect citizens and support warfighters. The software they run on is a live target, and insecure code here lands on real people, not a risk register. If you want real impact, this is the seat. If it is just another territory, it is not.

What You Can Expect

  • A founding mandate for ASD in Europe with direct access to leadership. Short decision lines, big ownership, room to ship fast.

  • Compensation and equity benchmarked to the mandate rather than the title, with real upside on the deals you close.

  • Latitude on how you present yourself in the market. High trust, flexible hours, zero corporate BS. We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

Benefits

    • Time Off: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO).

    • Annual reimbursement allocation for certifications and ongoing education.

This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025." jobs.excerpt: This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.
jobs.description:
This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.

About How-To Geek

How-To Geek is an online tech publication reaching millions of readers with practical tutorials, tech news, explainers, and buying advice. We help everyday users and tech enthusiasts understand how technology works, solve technical problems, and choose the right gear for their needs.

About the Role

How-To Geek is seeking a Freelance Deals Writer to cover daily technology sales, product discounts, and promotional shopping events. In this role, you will identify high-value price drops across PC hardware, mobile devices, smart home equipment, and consumer electronics, delivering clear, straightforward analysis on why a deal is worth buying.

Working closely with our editorial team, you will evaluate historical pricing data, break down product specifications, and publish timely, well-formatted deal coverage in a fast-paced environment.

Coverage Areas Include:

  • PC Hardware & Components: Storage/SSDs, Networking, RAM, GPUs, Power Supplies, PC Building
  • Consumer Electronics & Peripherals: Laptops, Monitors, Keyboards, Mice, Audio Gear
  • Smart Home & Homelab: Smart Displays, IoT Devices, Security, Single-Board Computers (SBCs), Networking Gear
  • Mobile & Accessories: Android/iPhone Devices, Tablets, Power Banks, Chargers
  • Software & Subscriptions: Apps, Cloud Services, VPNs, Productivity Tools
  • Entertainment & A/V: Smart TVs, Streaming Devices, Soundbars, Home Audio

Job Responsibilities:

  • Track down, evaluate, and publish timely coverage on major tech price drops, discount events, and curated product deals.
  • Analyze deals to ensure genuine value by evaluating historical pricing data, specifications, and product quality.
  • Contribute reliably and consistently under tight, time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Coordinate directly with the editorial team for assignments, pitch approvals, and feedback.
  • Input work and format product links directly into our in-house CMS according to editorial guidelines.

Application Requirements:

  • Proven track record writing tech deals, buying guides, product roundups, or hardware coverage in English.
  • Familiarity with price-history tools and identifying true historical low prices versus inflated MSRPs.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively within U.S. time zones.

How to Apply:

Please submit the following materials in your application:

  1. Your CV
  2. A brief Cover Letter sharing your background in tech and commerce writing
  3. 2–3 relevant writing samples (published tech deals, buying guides, or product reviews)

The hiring team at How-To Geek will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you’d make a solid addition to the team. Only applications containing relevant writing samples will be considered.

Shape the Future of Leadership Across Our Operating Companies

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our company by identifying and securing top-tier executive talent? As a Senior Executive Talent Partner, you will be at the heart of our success, working with senior leadership to drive the strategy and execution of critical hiring decisions. In this role, you will directly impact the leadership teams that guide our diverse portfolio of operating companies.

This isn’t just about filling roles; it’s about identifying leaders who will drive bold strategies, build high-performing teams, and push our businesses to new heights. Your expertise will fuse innovative talent acquisition strategies with internal development initiatives, all while ensuring an exceptional, inclusive experience for every candidate.

What You'll Do:

  • Shape Executive Leadership: Partner with business segment leaders to define talent strategies for key positions, including Presidents and other executive roles, ensuring we build teams that drive long-term business success.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Serve as a key consultant to senior leadership, guiding the executive recruitment process from candidate sourcing and screening to interviews and offer negotiations.
  • Build Talent Pipelines: Manage and cultivate executive talent pipelines of internal and external talent using advanced sourcing methodologies, tools, and systems to ensure we always have the right talent, ready to lead.
  • Collaborate and Influence: Work closely with internal stakeholders to align recruiting strategies with the unique needs and growth objectives of each operating company.
  • Leverage Data for Impact: Use analytics and data insights to continuously optimize recruitment processes, ensuring you deliver best-in-class outcomes while driving continuous improvement.
  • Drive Competitive Advantage: Translate market trends and insights into actionable talent strategies that enable our business to stay ahead in an ever-evolving landscape.
  • Provide Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and mentor both new and existing team members, strengthening our collective capabilities.

What You Bring:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience in a mid-to large size executive search firm and/or as a member of a best-in-class in-house executive search team highly preferred.
  • Proven experience in leading full-cycle executive recruitment efforts and partnering with senior leaders to drive talent initiatives that fuel business growth.

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We are hiring a Software Engineer for the Automation team to use AI to solve and automate manual work across Coalition. This is a hands-on AI engineering role: authoring skills, wiring agents to our systems of record through MCP, building evals, and deploying agents that non-engineers depend on every day. You will not be starting from zero. We have early workflows live in production, more proofs of concept in the oven, and working hypotheses about how all of this should fit together. We want someone who will pressure test those hypotheses against their own experience and change our minds where we have it wrong. Deep, current, practical experience building with LLMs is the single most important qualification for this job.

The other half of the role is proximity to the business. Think of this as a Forward Deployed Engineer, pointed inward: your customers are other Coalition teams. You will work directly with the teams whose work we are automating, learn how they actually operate, and turn that into a playbook. Getting from that conversation to something an agent can run reliably is the core of the work. You will also work day to day with our data team to get at the data these agents depend on. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

Responsibilities

  • Author skills: Turn a team's process, judgment, and edge cases into reusable skills that agents can invoke. Write them so the next project can reuse them instead of rebuilding them.
  • Build within our agent architecture: Wire agents to the systems of record through MCP servers, compose skills and tools into working workflows, and add new MCP surface area when a system we need is not covered yet.
  • Build evals: Define what "correct" means with the business team before you build. Build the eval set, establish a baseline, and use it to make calls about what ships. Nothing goes live on vibes.
  • Deploy and support agents: Take agents from prototype to production, including permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and rollback. Tune from how they behave once real users are in front of them, and leave behind docs and an owner on the business team who can run it without you.
  • Partner with the data team: Work with our data engineers on the access, models, and quality of the data your agents read and write. Bring them requirements early rather than working around them.

Skills and Qualifications

  • AI application building (primary): Substantial hands-on experience shipping LLM-backed applications: prompting, tool use, agentic loops, and multi-step workflows. You know where these break and how to contain the damage when they do. You have shipped at least one agent that non-engineers depend on.
  • Agent tooling: Practical experience with MCP, skill or tool authoring, and orchestrating agents against real systems of record.
  • Evals: You have built eval sets and used them to make decisions, not just to make a slide look good.
  • Coding agents: Fluent with agentic coding tools like Cursor. You use them to move faster inside codebases you did not write.
  • Core development: Strong Python. Comfortable with SQL and working directly against production data models.
  • Business fluency: You can sit with a non-technical operator, map their process, and translate it into requirements without a PM in the room.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Undocumented processes, half-broken internal tools, and unclear ownership are the normal starting conditions. You find the thread and pull it.
  • Shipping discipline: Git, CI, containers, and enough operational instinct to deploy your own work and keep it healthy.
  • Experience: At least 5+ years of hands-on software development experience. It's not the years, it's the miles.
