ROLE SPECIFICATION

IT and Compliance Manager

Operations · Reports to: Kieran Frost (Chief Operating Officer)

About Sendmarc

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Missionof the role

Own Sendmarc’s internal IT operations and the operating side of our information security compliance programme: the systems, devices, and access that keep the business running day to day, and the SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence, controls and policies that keep us credible with the customers and partners who ask hard questions about security.

Why This Role Exists

Sendmarc sells trust for a living. We’re a cyber security company, and our own security posture is part of our product story.Our ISO 27001 certification, our SOC 2 Type II report,and our Trust Centre exist to let prospects self-serve security questions, reduce friction in deals, and show that we practice what we preach. Compliance isn’t a background operational task here; it’s a strategic asset.

Outcomes

The four core outcomes this role is accountable for:

  • IT Operations & Support:Own internal IT for Sendmarc’s global, fully remote team: helpdesk and device support, identity and access management (onboarding/offboarding provisioning across our core systems), and administration of tools like 1Password,Microsoft 365, and Entra.
  • Compliance & Audit Management Own the operating programme for our ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II report via Vanta: evidence collection, control monitoring, clearing flagged items, and coordinating directly with auditors. Keep our Trust Centre (trust.sendmarc.com) accurate, current, and something Sales can point to with confidence.
  • Security Risk & Remediation Tracking Maintain the risk register, triage and track remediation of security findings (penetration test and vulnerability scan results) through to closure, and own our information security policy set.
  • Vendor & Access Governance:Administer access reviews and sharing permissions across core systems, and support third-party/vendor risk reviews alongside Finance, and own the security awareness training and phishing simulation programme with our Chief People Officer

Competencies

TECHNICAL

  • Hands-on IT administration experience: device management, identity and access management, helpdesk/ticketing
  • Comfortable administering SaaS platform security settings
  • Working understanding of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 frameworks and their evidence requirements
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, or similar)
  • Basic grounding in infrastructure/network security concepts: enough to triage a vulnerability finding and know who needs to see it

COMPLIANCE & RISK

  • Has sat on the “prep” side of a SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 audit before
  • Comfortable owning a risk register and tracking remediation items to actual closure
  • Able to translate audit and regulatory requirements into practical, low-friction internal process
  • Experience drafting or maintaining information security policy documentation
  • Familiar with the ISO 27001 clause 9 cycle (internal audit and management review)

WAYS OF WORKING

  • Proactive communicator: flags issues and drives them to resolution
  • Comfortable being the point of contact
  • Treats IT support as a service function, not a bottleneck for the rest of the business
  • Takes ownership: this is the “buck stops here” seat for IT and compliance, not a coordination-only role

EXPERIENCE

  • 3–5+ years in IT management, information security, or compliance-focused roles
  • Hands-on SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001 audit experience
  • Experience supporting a distributed, multi-country remote workforce is a strong plus
  • Cyber security industry background is a nice-to-have, not required

Primary Tools: Vanta, Microsoft 365 andSharePoint, Entra, 1Password, Slack

Who We're Looking For

You’re the person who actually wants to own IT and compliance, not tolerate it. You see a strong security posture as a competitive edge, not a checkbox, and you get real satisfaction from a clean risk register, a Vanta dashboard with nothing flagged, and a laptop fleet that’s patched before anyone notices it needed to be.

One platform. Five buyer personas. Every touchpoint from first click to closed deal. We need the designer who can pave that road.

Synera connects hundreds of engineering tools with AI – but the engineering leaders we're trying to reach won't give us more than a few seconds. We need someone who can own a website that turns visitors into leads, design the social presence that keeps Synera top of mind and craft the graphics that stop the scroll.

You'll join a 6-person design team alongside our brand designer, motion and product designers. Your lane: the Synera website end-to-end, social media design, and graphic design across all marketing channels. You'll craft visitor journeys for specific buyer personas, design for conversion, and build repeatable AI-powered workflows that let a small team punch way above its weight.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We're looking for an AI-native Web/UX/Graphic Designer who owns how Synera shows up across the web: from the first ad impression to the demo request.

📣 Turn value stories into visitor journeys that generate leads

You work closely with product marketing and content to understand our buyer personas and what matters to them: from hand's on simulation engineers up to CEOs. Then you translate those value stories into visual narratives and map the journeys that guide each audience from first touch to demo request. Landing pages, campaign visuals, infographics, interactive content: you design the full path, not just individual assets. You think in funnels, iterate based on data (heatmaps, analytics, A/B tests), and measure what actually converts.

🌐 Own the website

You're the primary owner of the Synera website's design. New pages, redesigns, layout optimizations and design system: It runs through you. For larger implementations we work with a dedicated Webflow developer, but you should be comfortable making changes yourself updating content, spinning up landing pages from existing patterns, or tweaking layouts. You maintain and extend the website design system to keep things consistent as the site grows.

🤖 Scale output through AI workflows

This isn't about prompting DALL·E once in a while. You build repeatable, automated design workflows using tools like n8n, Claude, Nano Banana or whatever gets the job done, to scale asset production, templatize recurring formats, and free up time for the work that actually requires a human eye. You document these workflows so the team can use them too.

🎨 Create assets across every marketing channel

Social posts, email headers, event collateral, trade show materials, one-pagers, whitepapers, ads: if you're not on the website you help design and produce assets for campaigns across web, social, email, and print. In our small team, every hand counts.

🤝 Collaborate within the design team

As one of three designers in marketing, you work closely with Synera's brand/graphic designer and motion designer. You coordinate on brand evolution, design system, and shared asset libraries. Clear lanes, tight collaboration: you own web + social, the brand designer owns brand + asset production, the motion designer owns animation + video.

⚡ In the first 6 months:

  • You own the website end-to-end and have shipped visitor journeys for at least 2 target personas with measurable lead generation impact.

  • Your AI workflows are documented and integrated into the team's standard process.

⚡ By 12 months:

  • Website visitor journeys are data-driven and continuously optimized.

  • You've demonstrably scaled the team's design output through AI automation and templatization.

  • You independently manage web and social design for full campaigns, end-to-end.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Intermediate Level: 44,300-56,300€

  • Experienced Level: 55,000-72,800€

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You're in the front row of an AI transformation - supporting a product that is actively changing how the world's top engineering teams work, not a commodity.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in B2B web design, landing pages, and marketing asset creation

  • You have proven experience designing for lead generation and conversion - you understand what drives action, not just what looks good.

  • You're an expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • You have a track record of building repeatable AI-powered workflows. Not "I've used Midjourney" - we mean actual automation: n8n pipelines, LLM-based content-to-design workflows, batch processing, templated generation chains. You've built systems that scale output.

  • You understand responsive web design principles and can design layouts that are implementable, not just beautiful.

  • You've created assets across multiple channels: web, social media, email, print.

  • You bring UX thinking: you can map user journeys, structure information hierarchy, and design for specific audience segments.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity, taking a loose brief and getting started without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • You're comfortable working in Webflow. Not full builds, but landing pages, content updates, and layout tweaks without needing a developer for every change.

  • Your English skills are strong enough to work in an international business environment.

BONUS - CHERRY ON TOP 🍰

  • Front-end coding skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to prototype or implement without developer dependency.

  • Motion design / animation skills ( Lottie, After Effects, Rive).

  • Experience in B2B / SaaS / engineering-audience marketing.

  • Familiarity with analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar, heatmaps) to inform design decisions.

  • Experience with design systems at scale.

  • Print production experience.

  • B2 French for our expansion to France.

Synera is a place where everyone can grow and every voice is valued. However you identify yourself and whatever background you have, if this role excites you, please apply with your English CV (no photo and birth date needed :)) and portfolio. We'd also love to see a walkthrough of a repeatable AI workflow you've built - the system, not just the output.

Why Synera?

Synera is an AI automation platform for engineers that drastically accelerates product development, as proven by numerous customers in the automotive, aerospace, and consumer goods industries such as Airbus, BMW, EDAG, and Miele. We achieve this by integrating engineering tools, data, and expert knowledge into a low-code environment that helps engineers create digital coworkers and automate complex processes.

We change the way product development works and are looking for a Graphic/Web Designer (f/m/d). Do you want to join?

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Design team.

About Healthcare.com

Healthcare.com is a healthcare technology company building smarter ways to connect people and partners with the coverage, care, and solutions they need.

We’re three businesses, one company. Through Marketplace, Pivot Health, and TrustRx, our work spans health insurance marketplaces, flexible health coverage, and pharmacy, giving us more ways to solve meaningful problems across the healthcare ecosystem.

Healthcare doesn’t stand still, and neither do we. We’re curious, collaborative, and always looking for better ways to solve problems, use technology, and make an impact.

About The Role

The Growth Marketing Manager is a newly created role responsible for growing Pivot Health’s direct-to-consumer business across every channel that can produce profitable enrollments while assisting with B2B growth. Reporting to the Director of Insurance Marketing, this person owns the growth agenda for the channel: finding where traction exists, proving where it might, and scaling what works.

Day-to-day management of paid search sits with an established agency partner. This role sets the direction that partner works against, and spends the balance of its time making sure our conversion and attribution signal is accurate across paid, organic, email, and phone; testing new channels against a defined bar; and building the partner relationships that open new sources of volume.

This is a role for a growth marketer rather than a channel specialist. You will be measured on enrollments and contribution margin, not on activity, and you will have real latitude to decide where the next dollar and the next experiment go.

What You'll Do

Channel Growth & Scaling

  • Own the performance of paid search and paid social as channels — setting targets, allocating budget, and holding the agency partner accountable for volume, cost-per-acquisition, and return on ad spend

  • Manage acquisition budgets across channels, continuously reallocating spend toward the highest-performing sources

  • Direct campaign, keyword, audience, creative, and landing page strategy with the agency partner, and own the decisions that follow from what the tests show

  • Partner with Finance and Analytics to forecast spend, model unit economics, and hit blended CAC targets

Measurement & Attribution

  • Own the accuracy of the conversion and revenue signal returned to advertising platforms across paid, organic, email, and phone

  • Coordinate with Data and Engineering to specify, prioritize, and validate tracking work — including offline conversion uploads, click-ID capture, and how conversion value is defined

  • Own call attribution through Invoca end to end, connecting calls to dispositions, enrollments, and economic outcomes, and returning those events to the originating platform

  • Reconcile platform-reported performance against the internal source of record, and resolve the differences rather than reporting around them

  • Translate marketing requirements into scoped engineering tickets and carry them through to verified delivery

Organic & Partner Growth

  • Evaluate and onboard new acquisition partners, lead aggregators, and eCommerce sources

  • Develop organic social and content-led channels as potential growth surfaces, working with the Content Marketing Manager on execution

Testing & New Channel Development

  • Run a structured program of channel tests, defining the traction threshold and the measurement approach for each one before it launches

  • Identify and act on new channel opportunities to diversify and de-risk the acquisition mix

Collaboration

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to align acquisition targeting with retention and lifetime-value goals

  • Contribute the consumer perspective to Pivot Health’s positioning, messaging, and brand direction

  • Contribute to the Growth & Marketing roadmap and quarterly operating plan

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of growth marketing experience spanning multiple acquisition channels, with genuine depth in at least two of them

  • A track record of taking a channel from unproven to producing — you have found traction somewhere that did not have it before, and can explain how you knew it was real

  • Demonstrated success owning acquisition budgets and hitting CPA, ROAS, or CAC targets in a high-volume, direct-to-consumer environment

  • Deeply analytical — comfortable with data, attribution, funnel metrics, and building the business case for spend

  • Comfortable directing agencies and contractors — you have held an outside partner to a number and know the difference between activity and results

  • Experience building partnerships or affiliate relationships, including sourcing and negotiating them, not only managing them once signed

  • Able to work directly with data and engineering teams on measurement problems — scoping requirements, prioritizing them, and validating that what shipped actually works

As Senior Compensation Analyst, you own the day-to-day technical execution of Boldr's global compensation programmes and serve as the primary backup point of contact for the Senior Manager, Total Rewards on compensation operations. You are the team's deepest technical expert on job evaluation, market benchmarking, job architecture, and salary banding, and the first point of contact for compensation matters when the Senior Manager is unavailable.

You will help maintain our compensation structures, conduct job evaluations, and market benchmarking activities that keep Boldr's pay practices internally equitable and externally competitive.

You bring rigour and consistency to how Boldr levels roles and builds pay structures globally, lead cross-functional compensation projects end to end, and act as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact pay decisions. We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Compensation Strategy & Design

  • Shape Boldr's global compensation strategy alongside the Senior Manager, weighing in on how it should evolve as the business changes, and help maintain continuity of in-flight strategic initiatives when the Senior Manager is unavailable.
  • Own job leveling frameworks and salary structures day to day, and lead market benchmarking (e.g., Mercer, Radford), including scoping methodology and validating results.
  • Turn compensation data into inputs for financial planning, pay equity audits, and total rewards forecasting, and flag where the numbers suggest a change in approach.

Job Architecture & Leveling

  • Champion process improvement, including piloting and rolling out AI-enabled workflows to improve speed and consistency, and serve as a key technical advisor to People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on complex or high-stakes pay decisions and global offer strategies.

Governance & Compliance

  • Track local regulatory requirements (e.g., pay equity, wage transparency, labour laws) across regions and flag risk areas before they become problems.
  • Design and run internal audits and reviews, tightening compensation policies and documentation standards where gaps turn up, and build out related communications and training materials for People Leaders.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Serve as the primary backup point of contact for compensation matters when the Senior Manager is out or unavailable, and serve as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact pay decisions.
  • Prepare compensation findings, trends, and recommendations to People leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Mentor other Total Rewards team members on compensation methodology and best practices.

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • A strong technical and analytical thinker who can also step back and advise at a strategic level
  • Team-oriented with a customer-service approach and a willingness to mentor others

YOU HAVE…

  • 5+ years of experience in compensation analysis or total rewards, including experience in a global or multi-country environment.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in job evaluation, market benchmarking, job description creation, compensation analysis, and building salary bands.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with experience leading compensation projects from scoping through delivery.
  • Experience managing compensation systems (e.g., PayScale, Payfactors) and survey platforms (e.g., Mercer, Radford).
  • Deep understanding of global compensation frameworks, pay equity, and compliance standards.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise leaders on complex pay decisions.

  • Prior compensation experience in a BPO or staffing environment is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas and expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As a Social Media Manager, you will play a central role in shaping and executing the social media strategy for a professional football club with ambitious global growth goals. You’ll work closely with leadership to drive audience growth, strengthen community engagement, and build a globally recognized digital brand across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong creative instincts with deep platform expertise and a proven ability to grow audiences organically. Rather than functioning as a content coordinator or scheduler, you’ll act as the strategic and executional owner of the club’s social presence—developing content strategies, producing engaging content, monitoring performance, and continuously identifying new opportunities to expand reach and engagement.

Accountability

Your success as a Social Media Manager will be defined by your ability to build audience growth, increase engagement, strengthen brand visibility, and create scalable social media systems that support long-term digital expansion.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Social Media Strategy & Audience Growth

  • Own and execute the club’s organic social media strategy across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube.
  • Develop and maintain content calendars aligned with match schedules, transfer windows, club announcements, sponsorship initiatives, and key campaigns.
  • Drive follower growth, engagement, impressions, and overall audience expansion.
  • Identify emerging platform opportunities, content formats, and growth strategies.
  • Translate business and brand objectives into high-performing social content initiatives.

Content Development & Creative Execution

  • Produce and publish high-volume, platform-native content across multiple social channels.
  • Repurpose content from club assets, media partners, creators, and user-generated content.
  • Create engaging short-form and long-form content optimized for each platform.
  • Independently edit video content and adapt creative assets for different audiences and formats.
  • Maintain consistency in visual identity, storytelling, and brand presentation.

Community Engagement & Fan Experience

  • Actively engage with supporters and followers across all major social platforms.
  • Monitor comments, direct messages, audience sentiment, and community conversations.
  • Foster meaningful engagement and strengthen relationships with supporters.
  • Escalate reputation risks, audience concerns, and important feedback appropriately.
  • Help build a highly engaged and globally connected football community.

Match Day Content & Live Coverage

  • Lead social media execution across match days throughout the season.
  • Publish real-time content including highlights, reactions, results updates, and behind-the-scenes coverage.
  • Coordinate with internal media teams and stakeholders to ensure timely content delivery.
  • Maintain high-quality engagement and storytelling during live sporting events.
  • Support the club’s digital presence during key moments throughout the football calendar.

Performance Reporting & Optimization

  • Track and analyze key performance metrics including reach, engagement, impressions, video views, and follower growth.
  • Produce regular performance reports and strategic recommendations.
  • Identify content gaps, growth opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Apply platform insights and audience data to optimize future content performance.
  • Continuously refine social media strategies based on evolving trends and results.

Colleagues

You’ll work closely with the Director of Communications, club leadership, media teams, creative partners, and other key stakeholders to execute the club’s digital growth strategy and elevate its global presence.

At Oceans Talent, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As a Social Media Manager, your vertical focus will be on social media strategy, audience growth, content creation, and community engagement, while your horizontal focus will include brand development, creative storytelling, analytics, and digital marketing.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience managing social media accounts for brands, sports organizations, media companies, entertainment businesses, or similar high-growth consumer-facing environments.
  • Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube, including platform algorithms, audience behaviors, and content best practices.
  • Content Creation: Strong experience creating, editing, and publishing both short-form and long-form video content.
  • Audience Growth: Demonstrated success growing social media audiences organically and improving engagement metrics.
  • Creative Storytelling: Strong ability to develop compelling narratives, create engaging content concepts, and adapt messaging across different platforms.
  • Community Management: Experience engaging online communities, managing audience interactions, and building brand loyalty through social media.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written communication and storytelling skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Independence & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and execute consistently without requiring heavy oversight.
  • Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and ambitious growth objectives.
  • Availability: Willingness to support match-day coverage, including evenings and weekends when required.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Social Media Strategy: How you develop and execute growth strategies across multiple platforms.
  • Content Creation & Storytelling: How you create engaging content that drives audience engagement and brand growth.
  • Audience Development: How you build communities and grow social followings organically.
  • Performance Analysis: How you measure success, interpret data, and optimize content strategies.
  • Creative Execution: How you translate ideas into high-performing social content.
  • Stakeholder Management: How you collaborate with leadership and manage competing priorities.
  • Ownership & Initiative: How you independently drive projects forward and create impact.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the role

The AI Outcomes Manager is DevRev's unified post-sales owner — bringing Customer Success and Customer Support together into a single role. Instead of handoffs between siloed teams, you own accounts end-to end: resolving issues, driving adoption, managing escalations, and making sure customers extract measurable value from what they bought.
You manage each account by its health and needs — proactively spotting risk and opportunity — rather than by whether a given interaction is labelled "support" or "success." AI is your multiplier, not a tool you use on the side. Our AI agent handles first-line triage, ticket classification, routing, knowledge retrieval, and deflection — so you can focus on what AI can't do: complex judgment, strategic enablement, relationship building, and
driving outcomes. You'll be measured not just by what you do directly, but by how well you leverage AI to scale across a full portfolio.

What you'll own

Your portfolio — a book of enterprise and growth accounts under single, accountable ownership. The model protects depth over volume.
The customer relationship, end-to-end
— Own accounts from implementation and go-live through adoption, renewal health, and expansion.
— Be the customer's single point of trust — no handoffs, in good times and bad.
— Stay accountable for the outcome even when another team is responsible for the underlying work ("more accountability, less responsibility").

Implementation & go-live
— Align on scope, success criteria, and the value the customer is buying before kickoff. DevRev · Customer Experience — Customer Outcomes 1
— Validate what was sold against what's feasible; close gaps and secure sign-off.
— Own go/no-go readiness — flag risk and hold the line when a launch isn't ready. Ticket lifecycle, powered by AI
— Respond within SLA — AI drafts, you review and personalize.
— Validate and correct AI's classification and severity; your corrections train the model.
— Own tickets through resolution; decide workaround vs. code fix and route to engineering while staying the owner.

Adoption & value
— Track usage trends and flag drops early using AI anomaly signals; turn them into proactive outreach.
— Run enablement sessions; compare entitlements to actual usage and close adoption gaps.
— Translate usage into business value (time saved, cost avoided, deflection); build the roadmap into every business review.

Relationship & commercial
— Keep relationships multi-threaded and engage executive sponsors.
— Act on account signals before the customer raises a problem.
— Run renewal reviews ahead of expiry; source and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

Who we're looking for
— Technically oriented and AI-capable — comfortable with APIs, tracing issues, and explaining root causes to both engineers and customers.
— An owner — you can carry a large B2B portfolio end-to-end, from ticket resolution through business reviews.
— A strong communicator — you run customer calls confidently and write clear RCA reports and QBR materials.
— AI-native — you embrace AI as your operating layer, actively train the model, and measure your own leverage.
— Commercially aware — you understand ACV, track utilization, spot expansion signals, and connect usage to renewal confidence.
— Comfortable with ambiguity — this is a new operating model; you'll help shape it, not just follow playbooks.
— Deep in at least one domain — with the ability to cross-train and advise.


Qualifications
— Minimum a B.Tech (or equivalent bachelor's degree in engineering / technology), or a postgraduate degree in management (MBA or equivalent).
— 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support engineering, solutions engineering, CSM, or TAM).
— Hands-on with at least one of: ticketing systems, CRM, workflow automation, analytics platforms, or developer tools.
— Background in fintech, enterprise SaaS, or high-volume support environments preferred.
— Experience across both support and success motions is highly valued.

We are excited to welcome a talented Revenue Cloud Solution Architect to our Revenue Solutions team. This role is pivotal in driving business transformation and enabling organizations to unlock the full potential of their Go-to-Market strategies. By leveraging state-of-the-art Quote-to-Cash technologies, the Revenue Cloud Solution Architect will help optimize sales and finance alignment, streamline operational processes, and deliver scalable, impactful solutions.

Our team is committed to building a best-in-class organization. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully while collaborating with a dynamic group of colleagues, innovative clients, and trusted partners, including Salesforce and AI teams. As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for the success of solution designs, providing technical leadership, and delivering transformational and financially impactful client solutions.

Position Overview

The Revenue Cloud Solution Architect will lead the design, development, and implementation of Revenue Cloud and Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) / Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) solutions for digital transformation initiatives. This role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to ensure the delivery of tailored solutions that meet specific business requirements.

You will play a key role in modernizing Quote-to-Cash processes, driving efficiencies, improving sales performance, and scaling revenue operations. Your responsibilities will span both strategic vision and hands-on technical execution, ensuring that projects deliver measurable value and align with long-term business objectives.

Additionally, you will serve as a thought leader in the areas of Revenue Lifecycle Management, platform enablement, and systems integration, driving innovation and best practices across multiple initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design and Architecture

  • Architect Comprehensive Solutions: Design end-to-end Salesforce solutions tailored for Revenue Cloud, focusing on areas such as Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) and Invoicing.
  • Develop Blueprints: Create detailed architectural blueprints that incorporate integrations, customizations, and system configurations to ensure seamless functionality.

Quote-to-Cash Optimization

  • Evaluate Processes: Analyze existing product configuration, pricing, quoting, and ordering workflows to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
  • Implement Enhancements: Develop solutions that align with business goals, ensuring scalability, accuracy, and optimized performance across Quote-to-Cash processes.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Management

  • Engage Stakeholders: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including senior leadership, Sales Operations, IT, Legal, Accounting, and Finance, to define requirements and create roadmaps.
  • Ensure Alignment: Act as the primary liaison between technical and business teams, fostering effective communication and shared understanding of project objectives.

Implementation Leadership

  • Guide Projects: Lead the implementation of Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of all stakeholders.
  • Oversee Technical Execution: Provide strategic direction and manage all phases of the implementation process, including design, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

Customization and Integration

  • Leverage Tools: Utilize Salesforce-native tools and features, such as Product Catalog Management, Transaction Management, Dynamic Revenue Orchestration, and Invoice Management.
  • Manage Integrations: Oversee the integration of Salesforce with other enterprise systems (e.g., Netsuite, Avalara, Stripe, DocuSign) and ensure data integrity during migrations.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Stay Current: Keep up with Salesforce updates and industry trends, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and innovation.
  • Recommend Solutions: Evaluate and introduce new features, tools, and processes to enhance Salesforce-based workflows and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Salesforce Expertise: A minimum of 4+ years working with Salesforce, with at least 3 years specializing in CPQ and Billing projects.
  • Proven Track Record: Experience leading large-scale transformation projects, particularly in enterprise settings.
  • Financial Knowledge: Solid understanding of accounting operations, including billing, invoicing, payment processing, and revenue recognition fundamentals.
  • Metrics Mastery: Familiarity with financial metrics such as ACV, TCV, ARR, and other performance indicators, with the ability to model and explain calculations effectively.
  • CLM & E-Signature Tools: Hands-on experience with tools like Document Generation, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and e-signature solutions.
  • Integration Skills: Knowledge of integrating Salesforce with third-party platforms, including Netsuite, Avalara, Stripe, DocuSign, SureTax, Chargent, or Dynamics 365.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce Configuration: Proficient in Salesforce configuration, including objects, flows, Lightning components, and customizations.
  • Custom Solutions: Experience in building and extending custom quoting and pricing solutions on the Salesforce platform.
  • Development Skills: Familiarity with Apex and Omniscript is a plus.
  • Data Analytics: Expertise in Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and sales performance analytics.
  • Integration Tools: Knowledge of integration concepts and tools like MuleSoft, Workato, and REST/SOAP APIs.

Leadership & Communication

  • Effective Communication: Strong ability to present complex technical concepts in a clear, relatable manner to diverse audiences.
  • Team Leadership: Proven skills in mentoring and guiding cross-functional teams, including analysts, developers, and consultants.
  • Risk Management: Capable of identifying potential risks and communicating timeline adjustments effectively to stakeholders.

Business Acumen

  • Process Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Sales, Product Management, Billing, and Accounting workflows, and their interdependencies.
  • Go-to-Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Channel, Partner, and Marketplace go-to-market strategies.
  • Results-Driven: Proven ability to align Salesforce solutions with business objectives to deliver measurable performance improvements.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Salesforce Certified Revenue Cloud Consultant (strongly preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Omnistudio Consultant
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect (strongly preferred)

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

jobs.description:
Highlights:

Location: Poland

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,800 - €6,300 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.
But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.
Position Summary:

The Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity Consultant assesses the security posture and maturity of OT environments for clients across manufacturing, energy, utilities, and other critical infrastructure sectors. This role involves conducting stakeholder interviews, reviewing OT documentation, evaluating security practices against industry frameworks, and developing maturity assessment reports with remediation recommendations. The Consultant presents findings and strategic guidance to clients while working with Project Managers, Directors, and Delivery teams to manage project scope and timelines.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain current knowledge of OT security standards, regulatory developments, and industry trends through ongoing professional development and relevant certifications
  • Support and guide OT risk and security discussions with technical teams, operations staff, and executive stakeholders
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and review OT-related policies, procedures, architecture documentation, and compliance records to understand organizational OT environments and priorities
  • Assess client environments against OT security practices and compliance posture against IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NIST CSF, NERC CIP, NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, C2M2, and other relevant OT standards and frameworks
  • Develop maturity assessment and benchmarking reports identifying OT security gaps, current state findings, and prioritized remediation recommendations
  • Develop sequenced remediation roadmaps with prioritized activities, timelines, and implementation guidance to address identified OT security gaps
  • Advise clients on OT security program structure, governance frameworks, organizational roles and responsibilities, and recommended policies and procedures
  • Present assessment findings, risk analysis, and strategic recommendations to clients and their leadership through executive briefings and detailed reports
  • Support other Cyber Risk Advisory consulting engagements when necessary to maintain team capacity

What You'll Bring

  • At least 4 years of working experience in operational technology security, OT risk assessment, or related infrastructure security roles
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience demonstrating OT security expertise
  • Direct experience in OT environments such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other critical infrastructure sectors
  • Hands-on experience with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems
  • Knowledge of control system technologies, industrial automation architectures, and OT-specific networking environments
  • Expertise in OT security assessment frameworks including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and industry-specific requirements such as NERC CIP
  • Understanding of emerging OT regulatory requirements including NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, and other sector-specific directives
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities
  • Strong oral and written communication skills when presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points

  • GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional) certification
  • CISM certification
  • CISSP certification
  • GRID (GIAC Response and Industrial Defense) certification

jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of HR Programmes

Location: UK, Remote (some travel to HALO’s international programmes required)

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Reports To: HR Director

Direct Reports: IHRMs

Key Internal Contacts/Relationships: Head of HR Operations, HR Operations Team, Talent Acquisition Team, Head of Talent & Performance, ER, Programme Directors and Programme Managers, CFO, Finance, UK/HQ Functional Leads, Central support functions, ExCo (as required)

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Suppliers

Job Purpose: To provide senior strategic HR partnership to HALO's international programmes, supporting programme leaders to manage workforce, employee relations, safeguarding and organisational capability issues effectively across complex operating environments, while ensuring alignment with organisational policies, values and legal obligations. The role provides an auditable route for escalation of complex or sensitive employment, conduct or safeguarding issues. The role holder ensures that people decisions affecting international programme staff are proportionate, timely and grounded in operational reality, while safeguarding independence from programme management and maintaining consistent standards of HR support across regions.

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

The role covers all HR partnering activity for HALO's country programmes. It operates across multiple jurisdictions and employment frameworks and within varied funding models, including grant funded and fixed period contractual arrangements.

The role does not hold line management accountability for country (national) teams. Authority is exercised through professional judgement, influence and established governance, including determining escalation and acting as the senior HR adviser on complex people, safeguarding and workforce matters across HALO's programmes.

Responsibilities:

Strategic People Partnership:

  • Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on workforce, employee relations, leadership and organisational capability matters.
  • Support programme leaders to design and apply employment and contracting arrangements that are proportionate to programme duration, funding terms and operational need.
  • Provide senior level HR advice that supports programme leaders to operate effectively in complex, resource constrained environments.
  • Oversee workforce planning and contracting approaches suited to different operating contexts, ensuring structures remain flexible enough for programmes to scale capacity up and down as operational need changes.

Employee Relations and Safeguarding:

  • Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on complex people, safeguarding and duty of care matters, providing expert, decision-focused advice that supports timely and proportionate resolution, but with programme leadership retaining ownership of decisions and outcomes.
  • Support programme leaders to anticipate and address people challenges arising in fragile, high-risk and resource-constrained operating environments.
  • Maintain oversight of significant people and safeguarding matters across programmes, ensuring consistency of approach, proportionality of response and appropriate escalation in line with organisational standards.
  • Ensure that significant people and safeguarding considerations are appropriately communicated to Executive and Board stakeholders, with clear articulation of context, options and mitigations.

Policy Application and Standards:

  • Interpret and apply global HR policies within diverse local and legal contexts, exercising professional judgement where policy intent, donor conditions and operational reality intersect.
  • Support programme leadership to understand and meet their legal, safeguarding and people-management obligations across multiple jurisdictions, balancing compliance with operational effectiveness.

Assurance and Risk:

  • Support the delivery of the HR assurance programme through reviews of workforce practices, employee relations, safeguarding, duty of care and people management arrangements across programmes.
  • Provide professional judgement on programme-level workforce risks, control effectiveness and compliance with organisational standards, identifying themes, emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Support programme leadership to implement agreed corrective actions and strengthen people management practices following assurance reviews.

Leadership and Capability Development:

  • Strengthen people management capability across programmes through coaching/mentoring, advice and support on complex workforce, employee relations matters, training, performance, development and succession planning.
  • Support programme leaders to apply organisational people policies and processes confidently and consistently.
  • Manage and develop the Regional HR network, ensuring consistent regional support, visibility of ER and safeguarding matters, and early intervention on emerging issues.
  • Ensure HALO’s values and standards are reflected consistently in people decisions and leadership behaviour across programme teams.

Interface with HR Operations:

  • Act as the primary interface between programme teams and HR Operations, ensuring workforce challenges, operational realities and programme feedback inform the continuous improvement of HR policies, systems and processes, and supporting the consistent application of organisational standards across programmes.
  • Work jointly with the Head of HR Operations to maintain common standards, shared escalation routes and a joined-up approach to case handling across the organisation.

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures, especially the code of conduct and safeguarding

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional travel to programmes globally

Requirements

Technical / Professional:

  • Significant leadership experience, including in international, multi-jurisdictional or complex operating environments.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing remote teams effectively across multiple countries or regions.
  • Experience providing senior level advice to non-HR leadership and operating with autonomy in ambiguous or fast-moving situations.
  • Ability to calibrate HR responses appropriately, distinguishing between complex, high-risk cases and matters that can be resolved pragmatically and proportionately.
  • Deep expertise in employee relations, safeguarding and managing complex people issues in international environments.
  • Strong understanding of UK employment law and law across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Advanced professional judgement in ambiguous, high-risk environments.
  • Ability to translate complex risk into clear, decision focused advice.
  • Strong understanding of embedding a safeguarding assurance framework.

Behavioural / Leadership:

  • High credibility and gravitas with senior operational leaders.
  • Influential without authority; confident challenger.
  • Calm, measured and values-led under pressure.
  • Strong ethical judgement and organisational awareness.
  • Ability to develop and lead HR teams across multiple jurisdictions.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience working within a not-for-profit / global matrix organisation.
  • International employment law knowledge

Benefits

  • 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 statutory holidays
  • Non-contributory life assurance
  • Private medical insurance
  • Pension contributions matched by HALO up to 5%
  • Emergency medical insurance while travelling overseas
  • Flexible working policy

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by 24th September 2026. Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

This is a paid freelance and remote position

ScreenRant is the #1 entertainment website and publishes breaking news and exclusives on blockbuster movies, TV shows, comic books, books, and other forms of entertainment.

As a worldwide leader, ScreenRant operates at a rapid pace and is always looking for experienced and passionate contributors who can create original high-quality content in a timely manner.

We are currently expanding our books coverage and looking for generalist book fans who can tackle big, broad recommendation lists and keep readers on top of what to read next.

Please note: this is not a book reviewer position. We do not publish reviews at this time. The bulk of this work - roughly 80% - is recommendation and ranking lists, with the remainder made up of book news and features. If your goal is to write critical reviews of individual titles, this role is not the right fit.

Your Responsibilities

  • Write list and feature articles in ScreenRant's house style following the training and peer mentorship period.
  • Cover current and upcoming book releases and book news.
  • Stay on top of new releases across multiple genres.
  • Brainstorm, pitch, and develop original content ideas.
  • Communicate actively with the Editorial Team.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Consistent and timely payments.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Remote freelance position to work from a location of your choice.
  • Exposure to ScreenRant's large and passionate audience, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Experience and Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Journalism, English Literature, or a related field/equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience writing about books, or experience writing on other topics in a credible publication plus evidence of book expertise through review platforms or socials.
  • A broad working knowledge of the book and publishing landscape as a generalist reader - comfortable writing broad lists and recommendations rather than covering a single niche.
  • Reads across science fiction/fantasy AND at least one other major genre. Readers who stay within a single genre (e.g. only romance, only horror, or only literary fiction) are not a fit for this role.
  • Actively keeps up with new and upcoming releases.
  • Strong, demonstrable comfort with the list format and fast turnaround times.
  • A quick learner with a strong sense of urgency and drive.
  • An excellent writer in the English language free of grammatical and spelling errors.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment.

Considered an Asset

  • Freelance writing experience with comparable entertainment, pop-culture, or books publications.

  • An active Bookstagram or BookTok with a significant following.

  • Experience in any capacity with review/tracking platforms such as BookBub, StoryGraph, Goodreads, or Fable.

How to Apply

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV
  • A cover letter

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process.

Valnet , founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.
