jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission: To achieve Sleek’s Australian revenue targets by renewing services across the existing clientele, driving cash collection through upsell and upgrades, and delivering a seamless, high-satisfaction customer experience throughout the renewal lifecycle.

Outcomes:

Renewal Rate and CSAT Targets

  • Consistently achieve monthly renewal rate targets across the Australian client base
  • Maintain and improve CSAT scores, ensuring customer trust and satisfaction throughout each renew

Customer Investigation & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct detailed, end-to-end investigations into customer interactions with Sleek
  • Work cross-functionally with accounting, corpsec, product, and data teams to drive resolution and support seamless renewals

Cash Collection via Renewal, Upsell & Upgrades

  • Achieve monthly cash collection targets by driving renewals and identifying upsell and upgrade opportunities
  • Proactively identify and act on revenue expansion opportunities within the existing customer base

Pipeline Management & Monthly Targets

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of the book of business; manage the pipeline in a data-driven manner using CRM and reporting tools
  • Prioritise ticket resolution and proactive outreach to consistently achieve monthly KPIs

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Best Practice

  • Partner with accounting, corpsec, product, and data teams to improve renewal processes and the end-to-end customer experience
  • Proactively share best practices with the wider Customer Success team; contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Must-have experience:

To do this, you will have a minimum of 8 years experience in Renewals, or Customer Success management roles and you will be located in the Philippines.

  • Demonstrated track record of achieving renewal rate and cash collection targets in a B2B SaaS or services environment
  • Experience managing a customer pipeline in a data-driven way: CRM hygiene, pipeline reporting, and forecasting
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with product, finance, and operations teams to resolve customer issues
  • Strong written and spoken English; ability to communicate clearly with Australian-market clients

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking & Target Focused: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, keeping in view our business goals and being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness, build empathy, trust and great working relationships. Strong language proficiency in English is required

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One Way Video Interview / Screening call with TA

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a ~30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail..

Technical round
A ~60-minute session with the Hiring Manager, including a live case study and roleplay—acting as if you’re already in the role—to test your role fitment. They will also discuss your last 1–2 roles to explore your background in more detail.

Behavioural fit assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Pharmaceutical Development & Operations, the Senior Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Celcuity’s small molecule pipeline and support of commercial assets. This role focuses primarily on establishing robust CMC analytical methods, specifications, and stability programs at CDMOs, while providing streamlined oversight for outsourced PK and toxicokinetic (TK) assays.

The Senior Director will be the subject matter expert on analytical development approaches, techniques and testing, APIs and drug products ranging from early development to commercial support.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead analytical development and material characterization for existing and new compounds appropriate to the phase of development.
  • Establish the phase-appropriate strategy for small molecule drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP) analytical methods, including, solid-state characterization, and impurity profiling.
  • Provide expertise in various analytical testing including DSC, IR, particle size, GC, mass spectrometry, XRD, and common pharmaceutical methodologies.
  • Oversee external CDMO partners in the development, optimization, qualification, validation, and transfer of robust analytical methods. Troubleshoot analytical testing issues and non-conformances, determine root causes, and optimize testing procedures.
  • Support formulation development with material testing, impurity and degradation identification. Support pre-clinical test article characterization.
  • Serve as the technical authority to investigate and resolve complex analytical deviations, out-of-specification (OOS) results, and stability trends.
  • Author and review analytical CMC sections and relevant bioanalytical components for IND through NDA stage, and for ROW regulatory submissions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s degree in a physical science field, ideally analytical chemistry, or closely related sciences.
  • ≥ 12 years in analytical chemistry of small molecule testing. Biologics and similar large molecule experience will not contribute to the experience total.
  • Experienced with early development activities including IND-enabling development.
  • Adept with API and impurity testing. Individuals with drug product only experience will not be considered.
  • Preferred direct experience supervising outsourced biological sample analysis (i.e., plasma concentration analysis) using LC-MS/MS in compliance with GLP and FDA/EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation guidelines.
  • Expertise in analytical technologies including LC, GC, NMR, MS, XRPD, and other relevant methodologies used for elucidation and purity determination.
  • Well-informed of FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines for drug substance manufacturing and quality assurance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to influence and build credibility at all levels.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for interacting with employees and leaders across various levels and functions.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple processes and documentation requirements.
  • Strong technical and analytical skills with advanced knowledge in MS Office including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required.
  • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and delegate
  • Demonstrated independent and sound decision-making skills; ability to think critically and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Maintain a positive, approachable and professional attitude.

ABOUT CELCUITY:

Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. The company's first FDA-approved product is REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), a potent, pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor that comprehensively blockades the PAM pathway. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

The Phase 3 VIKTORIA-2 trial is evaluating gedatolisib in combination with palbociclib and either fulvestrant or letrozole for the first-line treatment of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. A Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer, is ongoing.

jobs.description:
The ASR Engineer joins Omilia's Delivery ASR team to own the development, tuning, testing, deployment, and live performance of Omilia's ASR technology for enterprise customers' production IVR and voice-channel deployments. This role carries substantial responsibility and ownership: the ASR Engineer leads ASR solutions end-to-end, coordinating with other teams as needed, and is trusted to make sound judgment calls and manage their own work to meet tight deadlines.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end ASR tuning, model, and grammar delivery for a portfolio of live enterprise IVR/voice deployments, from requirements through go-live and ongoing optimization.
  • Own root-cause investigation and resolution of production ASR issues, ensuring rapid recovery of customer-facing voice channels under time pressure.
  • Own the technical relationship for assigned enterprise accounts, acting as the primary ASR delivery point of contact with customer and partner stakeholders.
  • Drive measurable WER/SER improvements against production baselines through acoustic and language model design and fine-tuning, including modern neural approaches.
  • Contribute to and help scale delivery automation to reduce manual turnaround across the team's release cadence.
  • Ensure ASR solutions perform reliably across the team's production infrastructure and deployment environments spanning multiple global regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune ASR grammars, acoustic models, and language models for new locales, domains, and customer-specific vocabularies.
  • Design, train, and fine-tune acoustic and language models, including modern neural approaches, with measurable WER/SER improvement.
  • Investigate and resolve production ASR issues such as recognition failures and showstopper defects, engaging directly with internal and external customer/partner stakeholders.
  • Run customer working sessions and translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Represent ASR delivery in cross-functional forums with Product, Support, and Project Management.
  • Build and maintain grammar-generation and other delivery automation pipelines to speed up release cycles.
  • Monitor live ASR performance and proactively flag and address degradation before it affects customers.
  • Deploy and validate ASR updates across production infrastructure spanning multiple global regions.
  • Document tuning decisions, model versions, and configuration changes for auditability and knowledge sharing.

Requirements

Required:

    • 5+ years of hands-on ASR/speech engineering experience, with substantial experience in production/live IVR or voice-channel deployments.
    • Demonstrated track record supporting customers directly, ideally in regulated industries (banking, insurance, healthcare).
    • Strong hands-on experience with ASR platforms such as Kaldi (or equivalent) — language modeling, acoustic modeling, grammar/lexicon design, and decoder tuning are required, not "nice to have."
    • Solid programming ability (Python preferred; Bash, Java, or C++ also acceptable) and comfort in Linux environments.
    • Academic background in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computational Linguistics, Speech & Language Processing, or equivalent hands-on experience — a degree does not substitute for production experience at this level.
    • Excellent spoken/written English and strong stakeholder communication skills; this role speaks directly with enterprise customers and partners.
    • Comfortable owning ambiguous, production-critical problems independently, prioritizing across multiple accounts, and working under demanding deadlines.

Nice to have:

    • Experience with modern neural ASR frameworks (e.g. wav2vec2, Whisper, or similar end-to-end models).
    • Exposure to telephony/CCaaS platforms and IVR architectures.
    • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and MLOps practices for model deployment and monitoring.
    • Additional spoken languages beyond English.

  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior Mulesoft Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced MuleSoft Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration solutions on the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role you will own the integration lifecycle, including API design, flow development, deployment, observability, and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on MuleSoft experience with strong API-led connectivity practices, and will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, and integration partners to deliver reliable, secure, and reusable integration assets. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration flows in MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, including DataWeave transformations, error handling, and reusable connectors.
  • Apply API-led connectivity (System, Process, Experience APIs) to deliver reusable, composable integration assets.
  • Design and publish well-documented APIs using API Designer and the Anypoint Exchange.
  • Configure and manage runtimes (CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, Hybrid) appropriate to workload requirements.
  • Implement strong API security using OAuth2, mTLS, JWT, and Anypoint API Manager policies.
  • Build event-driven integrations using Anypoint MQ, Salesforce Platform Events, or Kafka.
  • Optimize integration performance, including pooling, caching, parallel processing, and message size management.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for MuleSoft applications using Maven, Anypoint CLI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Migrate legacy integrations from other middleware (Oracle SOA, BizTalk) to MuleSoft.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Anypoint Monitoring and external observability tools.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards.
  • Collaborate closely with security, enterprise architecture, and application development teams, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of integration experience with strong focus on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, and Mule runtime.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and RAML/OAS API design.
  • Hands-on experience with CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or Hybrid deployment.
  • Experience with API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, JWT) and Anypoint API Manager.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD for MuleSoft.
  • Familiarity with event-driven integration using Anypoint MQ or Kafka.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience integrating with major SaaS platforms (Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow).
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Developer or Architect credentials.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud deployment of Mule runtimes.
  • Familiarity with FinOps and integration cost management.
  • Experience implementing zero-trust API security models.
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs on Anypoint Platform.

jobs.title: Open-Source Intelligence Mentor CZ
jobs.excerpt: XPUPXPUP vznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
jobs.description:
XPUP

XPUP vznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
To, co začalo v roce 2018 jako komunitní iniciativa v Tbilisi, se proměnilo v globální vzdělávací platformu s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří experti z praxe, jsou zaměřené na skutečné potřeby trhu a vedené v prostředí spolupráce, zvídavosti a růstu.

V roce 2023 jsme se spojili s Tether, abychom naši misi rozšířili do celého světa – zpřístupnit praktické a kariérně posilující vzdělávání všem, kdo chtějí růst.

Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.

Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.

A jsme teprve na začátku.

Přehled role

Do společnosti XPUP hledáme zkušeného odborníka na OSINT a korporátní bezpečnost, který se připojí k našemu týmu jako lektor kurzu OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence). Vaším úkolem bude připravovat a vést interaktivní workshopy, sdílet reálné zkušenosti z praxe a provázet studenty během celého studia. Pomůžete jim osvojit si dovednosti potřebné k tomu, aby dokázali sbírat, analyzovat a vyhodnocovat informace z otevřených zdrojů profesionálně, eticky a v souladu s právními normami.

Open-source intelligence je dnes klíčovou disciplínou v korporátní bezpečnosti, due diligence i vyšetřování. Tento kurz studentům poskytne praktické dovednosti potřebné k efektivní práci s OSINT a SOCMINT nástroji – od sběru dat ze sociálních sítí a veřejných registrů přes analýzu Dark Webu až po pokročilou síťovou rekognoskaci a geolokaci. Prostřednictvím praktických cvičení a reálných scénářů se studenti naučí pracovat s moderními nástroji i AI automatizací, porozumí etickým a právním hranicím OSINT a osvojí si zásady bezpečné a zodpovědné práce s informacemi.

Main Responsibilities

  • Sdílet se studenty své odborné znalosti a zkušenosti z praxe.

  • Připravovat a vést poutavé prezenční i online workshopy podle připravené osnovy, která propojuje teorii, praktické ukázky a interaktivní cvičení.

  • Podporovat, motivovat a provázet studenty během celého vzdělávacího procesu.

  • Vytvářet inspirativní, otevřené a podporující prostředí, které podněcuje aktivní zapojení, spolupráci a sdílení zkušeností.

  • Průběžně sledovat nové trendy v oblasti moderního pracovního prostředí a začleňovat aktuální poznatky, technologie a osvědčené postupy do výuky.

Requirements

  • Zkušenost na pozicích jako Corporate Security Specialist, Threat Intelligence Analyst, Forensics Specialist, Senior OSINT Consultant, Due Diligence Analyst nebo Intelligence Officer.

  • Ideálně 5–10 a více let praxe v oblasti korporátní bezpečnosti, kybernetické bezpečnosti, vyšetřování nebo analytických rolí.

  • Zkušenost ze specializovaných bezpečnostních a vyšetřovacích agentur, společností Big4 (Forensics/Risk Advisory), kybernetických bezpečnostních firem, advokátních kanceláří (litigation support) nebo z pozic analytika u zpravodajských či policejních složek je výhodou.

  • Silná znalost OSINT a SOCMINT, včetně sběru a analýzy dat z otevřených zdrojů, sociálních sítí, veřejných rejstříků a mezinárodních obchodních registrů.

  • Zkušenost s OPSEC a přípravou pracovního prostředí – operační bezpečnost, minimalizace digitální stopy, bezpečné nastavení prostředí a správa krycích identit.

  • Znalost výzkumu v Dark Webu a Deep Webu, včetně sítě TOR, skrytých služeb, monitoringu úniků dat, unikajících přihlašovacích údajů a stealer logů.

  • Zkušenost s síťovou a datovou rekognoskací – výzkum DNS a certifikátů, práce s nástroji Shodan a Censys, analýza metadat a vizuální geolokace z fotografií a videí.

  • Znalost moderních nástrojů a AI, včetně automatizace vyhledávání pomocí AI, web scrapingu/skriptování a nástrojů pro vizualizaci dat či link analýzu.

  • Aktivní zapojení v mezinárodních bezpečnostních nebo vyšetřovacích asociacích (např. ASIS, WAD) nebo v relevantních komunitách zaměřených na cyber threat intelligence je výhodou.

  • Dobrá znalost právních a etických hranic OSINT, včetně GDPR, ochrany osobních údajů a rozdílu mezi legálním sběrem informací a nelegálním hackingem.

  • Ideálně zkušenost s přednášením nebo výukou – vystupování na konferencích o kybernetické bezpečnosti, publikování výzkumu nebo vedení workshopů/školení pro firemní či státní klienty.

Co nabízíme

  • Přátelské a podnětné pracovní prostředí.

  • Samostatnost a kreativní svobodu při vedení kurzů.

  • Neomezený přístup ke všem kurzům XPUP (a slevy pro rodinné příslušníky).

  • Atraktivní referral program.

  • Příležitost pomáhat budovat novou generaci lidí, kteří rozumí datům a umí je využít v praxi.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.

SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGIST

Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week

This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.

VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.

We are looking for a skilled Social Media Strategist who operates at the intersection of digital marketing, data, and systems thinking. This person will own overarching social media strategy, email marketing, and campaign analytics for our clients, while leveraging automation and integrations to build scalable marketing ecosystems. Success in this role requires someone who is equally comfortable building a nurture sequence and interpreting campaign performance data to make confident strategic recommendations.

Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another's success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.

Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.

EXPECTATIONS

Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive and Professional Manner

  • Demonstrate an exceptional work ethic and a positive attitude in all client and team interactions.
  • Ensure all communication reflects VaVa's values and standard of professionalism.
  • Contribute to a thriving contractor community by embracing VaVa's culture and engaging with the broader team.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

  • Lead and manage client accounts with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Anticipate client needs, communicate progress proactively, and surface challenges before they become problems.
  • Solve problems independently without compromising the quality or consistency of work delivered.
  • Maintain careful attention to detail and a consistent commitment to excellence across all deliverables.
  • Track engagement hours accurately and communicate proactively when scope or availability needs adjustment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop overarching social media strategies for clients, including channel selection, audience targeting, content mix, and growth objectives.
  • Design and execute email marketing campaigns including newsletters, promotional sends, drip sequences, and audience nurture pipelines.
  • Build and manage automated workflows using tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n to connect social platforms, CRMs, and email systems.
  • Manage paid advertising campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and Amazon, including budget allocation, audience targeting, and performance reporting.
  • Define, track, and report on client-defined performance metrics across social media and email channels, translating data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Conduct audience research and develop buyer personas to inform platform strategy and content direction.
  • Integrate CRM platforms with social media and email tools to ensure seamless lead capture, segmentation, and follow-up.
  • Monitor SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) performance and website traffic metrics as they relate to social and email-driven acquisition, including visibility in AI-generated search results.
  • Identify opportunities to improve funnel performance and recommend strategic adjustments based on campaign data.
  • Provide clients with regular strategy reviews, performance summaries, and forward-looking recommendations.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, platform algorithm updates, and emerging tools relevant to client industries.
  • Manage project timelines, deliverables, and client communication across multiple accounts.
  • Recommend platform and tool integrations that improve efficiency and marketing outcomes for clients.
  • Write content including blog posts, email copy, and web copy as needed to support broader campaign strategies.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated experience in social media strategy, digital marketing, and campaign management.
  • At least 2 years of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity.
  • Available at least 20 hours per week to support high-touch (daily), deliverable-focused clients.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing social media strategies across multiple platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, or HubSpot.
  • Experience building automated workflows using Zapier, Make (Integromat), n8n, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency managing paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Amazon Ads.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Dubsado, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytics and reporting skills using native platform analytics and tools such as Google Analytics.
  • AI literacy and demonstrated familiarity with AI tools applicable to marketing workflows and strategy.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and at least one project management tool.

Preferred

  • Experience with API integrations and basic understanding of how platforms connect at a technical level.
  • Familiarity with SEO and AEO principles and tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console.
  • Familiarity with social media content strategy and basic graphic design or video tools.
  • Background in funnel architecture, lead scoring, or advanced segmentation within CRM platforms.

EDUCATION

A degree is not required for this role. Demonstrated competency and a consistent commitment to professional growth carry more weight than credentials. Candidates without a degree should hold at least one relevant certification, such as a HubSpot Marketing certification, Google Analytics or Ads certification, Meta Blueprint certification, or equivalent.

A commitment to continued learning is an expectation of this role. Staying current in a field that evolves as quickly as digital marketing is part of what it means to do this work well.

Since 2013, we have powered exchanges, brokerages, banks, and fintechs across dozens of countries, giving them the trading, custody connectivity, tokenization, treasury, and settlement capabilities they need to operate in digital assets at institutional scale.

We are not a collection of products in a box. AlphaPoint is a single platform with many capabilities: one integration that lets a client offer trading, brokerage, treasury, and stablecoin workflows to their end users, connect to the liquidity venues, custodians, and banking partners of their choice, and expand into new use cases without re-platforming. Every super app needs a super platform underneath it. That is what we build.

About the Role

We are hiring a Sales Executive to open new markets for the AlphaPoint platform, with APEX (our trading and brokerage infrastructure) and APEX Treasury (our treasury and settlement layer) as the lead offerings. This is a new-business role. You will build your own pipeline, run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation to signature, and land accounts that grow with us as they add capabilities.

Our buyers fall into two groups. The first are firms launching a new exchange or brokerage and looking for the platform to build it on. The second, and larger, are firms that already have an established base of end users or assets and want to give those users access to digital assets: investment platforms and online brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth and RIA platforms, fintechs adding crypto to an existing product, and the retirement channel, where brokers and IRA providers are bringing bitcoin ETFs and spot crypto to retirement accounts.

This is a builder role for someone with deep domain knowledge. You know how a broker-dealer, an asset manager, or a wealth platform actually works, what they need from a technology partner to launch digital assets, and who inside the building signs off on it. You can hold a first meeting with a CEO and a working session with a head of trading or a CTO in the same day, and you can teach a market what it should be asking for.

What You Will Do

  • Own new-business revenue for the AlphaPoint platform in your territory, selling APEX and APEX Treasury as an integrated platform rather than as standalone products, and consistently meet or exceed quota.
  • Build pipeline from scratch through your own network, targeted outbound, referral and partner channels, industry events, and content, with disciplined territory and account planning behind it.
  • Lead complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, product, technology, compliance, and legal, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and contract close.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market plays for each target segment: investment platforms and brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth, fintechs entering crypto, and retirement and IRA providers.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects on how to structure a digital asset offering: which capabilities to launch first, how to integrate with existing systems and custodians, and how to stay within the regulatory perimeter in each market.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineers, Product, and Engineering to scope integrations and pilots, and bring structured market and client feedback back into the roadmap.
  • Work with Marketing on segment-specific campaigns, case studies, and events, and represent AlphaPoint at industry conferences and forums to build visibility and credibility in your markets.
  • Maintain an accurate, well-qualified pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, with clear next steps and close plans on every opportunity, and report weekly on pipeline health and progress to target.
  • Resourceful and hands-on: finds a way to move a deal forward regardless of the tools or processes in place, and helps build the playbooks the rest of the team will use.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise or institutional sales experience in capital markets technology, fintech, and digital asset infrastructure, with a track record of closing six-figure, multi-year contracts and consistently achieving quota.
  • Deep domain knowledge of at least two of our target segments: online brokerage and investment platforms, asset management and institutional trading, private wealth and RIA platforms, fintech, or the retirement and IRA channel. You understand how these firms are structured, how they make money, and how they buy technology.
  • Working knowledge of the digital asset ecosystem, including trading and execution, qualified custody, stablecoins and settlement, and the regulatory considerations that shape how regulated firms approach crypto.
  • Proven ability to build pipeline independently. You have opened new accounts and new segments before, not only worked inbound or an installed base.
  • An established network among decision-makers at financial institutions, brokers, wealth platforms, fintechs, or custodians, and a demonstrated ability to turn that network into qualified opportunities.
  • Technical fluency to engage credibly with CTOs, heads of trading, and product leaders on integration, APIs, and platform architecture, and to translate that into business outcomes for the C-suite.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills across complex, multi-stakeholder deal structures, including partner-dependent deals where a custodian or liquidity provider is part of the solution.
  • Experience navigating regulated environments and a commitment to the highest ethical and compliance standards.
  • A data-driven approach to managing your business: rigorous CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and comfort using analytics and AI tools to prioritize and work your territory.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the presence to present to executive audiences and the clarity to write a proposal a CFO will read.

Preferred

  • Experience selling trading, custody, or market infrastructure technology to broker-dealers, asset managers, or wealth platforms (for example, OMS/EMS, execution, clearing, or custody connectivity).
  • Existing relationships with qualified custodians, ETF issuers or distributors, IRA and retirement-account providers, or crypto-native liquidity providers.
  • Experience in a venture-backed or growth-stage fintech where you helped define the sales motion rather than inherit it.
  • Familiarity with white-label and API-first platform models and the economics of platform partnerships.

How We Work

You will report to the VP of Sales and work closely with a small, senior commercial, product, and solutions team. We value people who are direct, curious about how our clients’ businesses actually run, and generous with what they learn. We move quickly, own our outcomes, and treat every client as a long-term partner rather than a transaction.

Title: Remote Sales Tax Accountant (Full-Time)

Location: Luzon island, Cebu City, Davao City, Iloilo City, Philippines (REMOTE WFH)

Shift: Flexible late shift - Core working hours from 8:30 PM - 1:30 AM PHT (remaining hours can be completed before or after that)

About The Role

TaxValet is looking for a Sales Tax Accountant to help our clients eliminate the hassle and risk of sales tax. As a team member of a growing start-up, you’ll work to ensure that each of your clients’ needs are taken care of each month. You will use your keen eye for attention to detail to solve time-critical problems for clients, submit sales tax filings, and contribute to improving the team’s workflows and processes. While this is a work-from-home position, we are currently looking for candidates in the Luzon area, Cebu City, Davao City and Iloilo City.

You are a self-starter, willing to learn on the job, and take ownership and pride over your work. The ideal candidate is comfortable with learning and using new technology and has some bookkeeping or accounting experience, and is comfortable working remotely. This requires having high-speed and reliable home internet.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who is ready to learn and grow professionally, and wants a career (not just a job). We can train you on a lot of things, but here are our non-negotiables:

Professional

  • 3+ Years of Accounting or Audit Experience: You know the ropes when it comes to accounting or auditing. Your expertise helps keep things running smoothly.
  • Multi-Client Master: Juggling multiple clients? You’ve got it covered. You can manage different priorities like a pro while keeping everything organized and on track.
  • Excel/Google Sheets Guru: Whether it’s complex formulas, pivot tables, or data analysis, you’re a spreadsheet genius who can turn numbers into insights faster than a spreadsheet can load!
  • Bonus Points for US Tax Knowledge and / or having your CPA: If you've got US tax experience up your sleeve, great! If not, no worries – we’ll help you get there.

Interpersonal

  • You’re detail-oriented and have a sharp eye for detail. You catch the little things that others miss and always deliver top-notch work.
  • You’re great at analyzing data and uncovering insights that others might overlook.
  • You have excellent time management. Deadlines don’t scare you! You’re a time management pro, always prioritizing outcomes and ensuring everything gets done efficiently and effectively.
  • You’re a multi-tasking pro! You can easily prioritize and balance competing demands, ensuring everything stays on track.
  • You’re always a team player at heart, and you never hesitate to share your learnings with your team or apply learnings gained from your collaboration with others.
  • You know how to follow rules and processes, but you’re also creative and think beyond the standard approach when necessary.
  • You’re always eager to learn new skills and technologies excite you! You’re always looking to expand your knowledge and grow professionally.
  • You’re an effective and comfortable communicator. Whether it’s writing, video chats, or phone calls, you communicate with ease and clarity in English. You’re comfortable getting your point across in any setting and love collaborating with others.
  • You are effective in bringing order and clarity to complex and chaotic situations.
  • You are not afraid to challenge the status quo and speak up when something doesn’t seem right. You’re confident in voicing concerns and advocating for what’s best for the team, clients, and TaxValet as a whole.

Please note that the final step before being hired is for you to arrange reference calls with your former managers and others.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare and submit sales tax filings. You will work with the clients to ensure their sales tax data is accurate and in a format compatible with the tax software, prepare estimated liabilities, and submit sales tax filings on a monthly basis.
  • Monitor clients' tax collection variances. On a periodic (typically monthly) basis, you will monitor the variance between tax collected and the calculated liability due, determine any issues and work to resolve said issues with clients when possible.
  • Provide assistance to resolve time-critical issues. Many clients come to us with notices from state sales tax authorities regarding assessments, collections, and past due returns. You will work closely with clients to resolve these issues and get their filings current. This often involves working with sales tax authorities to help our clients.
  • Assist with special client projects. You will assist with submitting late or amended sales tax returns, managing audits, and updating clients' company information with the states.
  • Internal documentation, workflows, and processes. You will be a key player in updating internal documentation for new and/or more efficient filing and account management processes, workflows, and tools used.
  • Be the primary point of contact for your clients. Once clients leave the onboarding process, you will be their primary point of contact for all services. You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and adequate communication between the team and the clients regarding any issues, sales tax filings, projects, or requests.
  • Learn New Skills. You will continue to learn and advance your understanding of sales tax and related technical skills on an ongoing basis to advance your career and increase the value you bring to the team.

Specific Measures of Success

No surprises here! After a year on the job, you’ll be measured by these specific outcomes:

  • Average timeframe for special project completion. On average, complete special projects within 60 days of client sign-off/approval to proceed.
  • Average timeframe for past due return project completion. On average, complete all known backfilings within 90 days of client onboarding completion.
  • Client tax variance percentage. Have 80% of clients with less than 3% tax collection variance (the difference between the tax collected and the amount due to the state).
  • Submitting returns on time. Have 99.9% of monthly filings submitted by state due dates.
  • Completion of online education and training. You will complete 3 hours per quarter of Sales Tax Institute Webinars or other educational training.

Compensation and Benefits

We believe working side-by-side with an awesome team is the greatest benefit there is, but there are other reasons why we love working at TaxValet including:

  • Monthly flat salary - 94,364.00 PHP
  • 43 days off per year. This includes 22 holidays per year, plus 21 days of PTO per year. Yes, seriously.
  • 3 additional days off per year to volunteer with a non-profit organization of your choice.
  • 100% Remote Working from Home.
  • The ability to participate in the company profit sharing program the year after your hire date (pending passing a financial literacy quiz.)

Some intangible benefits include:

  • Don't just take our word for it—see what our employees have to say:
    • We’re proud to have made the top 10 list for Best Remote Workplaces in America by Best Companies Group in 2023, 2025 & 2026
    • TaxValet has made the Inc 5000 list in 2023, 2024, and 2025
    • For the past 5 years, we've proudly maintained an impressive eNPS score of over 90!
    • Our team has consistently awarded us a 4.9-star rating on Glassdoor!
    • Come join us and find out why!
  • We encourage ongoing training, and learning and development, through munch and learns, coaching, the chance to work on diverse projects, our continuous education reimbursement program, and more!
  • We believe in and support growth opportunities. We take pride in promoting from within, and we encourage cross-department moves to explore new areas of the business and broaden your skill set.
  • We are proud to have a diverse team of employees where everyone’s voice matters. And we mean that! We have regular processes in place for everyone to share their feedback, thoughts and ideas.

Are You Our Next Teammate?

We’d love to be in touch. Please apply online with a resume and cover letter. Each application will be reviewed with intention and care. So, the more effort you put in up-front, the higher likelihood we’ll reach out. If there’s a mutual interest, we’ll reach out to you to collect additional information. Thanks, and we’re really looking forward to meeting you.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. FDH Aero is a trusted global supply chain solutions partner for aerospace and defense companies, helping to shape the industry by simplifying the supply chain. FDH is headquartered in Commerce, California, and has operations across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. At FDH Aero, we understand that the strength of our brand comes from our people.

We invest in driven, diverse and experienced professionals who are naturally curious, courageous and motivated towards action. We value tempering confidence with humility, and a mission that always starts with service-first.

Our values guide everything we do:

We Are Service First - We act with agility and intelligence to solve our partner’s most pressing needs. We safeguard our trusted relationships by communicating with clarity and unmatched follow through.

We Are Respectful - We behave with dignity, fairness, and acceptance. We thrive by prioritizing empathy, humility, and connection to our collective community.

We are Amplifiers - We invest in driven, diverse and experienced professionals, businesses and partners. We fuel the entrepreneurial spirit by providing autonomy, authority and a clear mission.

We Are Open-Minded - We communicate with intention, curiosity, and diversity of thought. By actively contributing with courage and candor, we challenge the status quo and innovate together.

We Are Accountable - We own responsibility for our outcomes. We set expectations, embrace critique, and empower every employee to take immediate actions on challenges they encounter.

We Value Our People - That’s why we offer competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), 401k matching, and wellness programs. We invest in training, mentorship, and career development to empower our employees to reach their full potential. Our commitment to culture and excellence has earned us recognition as one of Aviation Business News' Best Places to Work in Aviation.

As a team member at FDH Aero you are trusted to deliver, to innovate, and to drive next-generation solutions for tomorrow’s supply chain demands. Ready to make an impact? We proudly pursue top talent with a diverse and global set of experiences and backgrounds.

We Are Looking For

The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for the development, execution, and performance of FDH Electronics’ account strategy for a designated key customer. This position will drive profitable revenue growth, expand FDH’s position across customer programs and platforms, protect existing business, and strengthen FDH’s role as a strategic supply-chain partner. The Strategic Account Manager will establish senior-level relationships throughout the customer organization, develop a multiyear account growth strategy, and lead the pursuit of new business across FDH’s product and service portfolio. This position will direct the cross-functional execution of account priorities by aligning Sales, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, and executive leadership around the customer’s current requirements and long-term objectives.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

Strategic Account Ownership

  • Define and execute the account strategy for a designated key customer, aligning customer priorities with FDH’s commercial objectives, product capabilities, and long-term growth strategy.
  • Serve as the principal commercial leader and primary point of accountability for the overall customer relationship.
  • Establish FDH as a strategic partner by delivering solutions that support the customer’s technical, operational, program, and supply-chain objectives.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer business strategy, organizational structure, programs, platforms, sourcing priorities, technical requirements, and growth plans.
  • Establish multiyear objectives for revenue growth, gross margin, market penetration, customer retention, and strategic account development.
  • Provide executive leadership with regular assessments of account performance, strategic opportunities, competitive threats, and required investments.

Account Growth and Business Development

  • Develop and execute a formal account growth plan identifying addressable market, target programs, product expansion opportunities, competitive position, commercial priorities, and specific growth initiatives.
  • Drive new business development across customer programs, platforms, sites, and functional organizations.
  • Expand market share through cross-selling, new product introductions, engineering design-in activity, supplier consolidation, and value-added supply-chain solutions.
  • Identify business currently awarded to competitors and develop targeted strategies to capture or displace incumbent positions.
  • Lead the qualification, prioritization, and advancement of strategic opportunities from initial identification through award and implementation.
  • Develop opportunity-capture plans that define customer requirements, decision criteria, competitive dynamics, value proposition, commercial strategy, internal resources, milestones, and ownership.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline sufficient to achieve the account’s short- and long-term growth objectives.
  • Partner with Product Management and Procurement to align FDH’s supplier relationships, product portfolio, and inventory strategy with emerging customer demand.

Executive and Customer Relationship Development

  • Establish and expand relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across procurement, engineering, supply chain, program management, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
  • Develop a comprehensive stakeholder strategy that identifies decision authority, technical influence, organizational priorities, and relationship coverage.
  • Facilitate executive alignment between FDH and the designated customer to advance strategic initiatives, resolve business issues, and strengthen the long-term partnership.
  • Lead customer engagement at all organizational levels, including strategic planning sessions, commercial negotiations, program reviews, and executive business reviews.
  • Maintain visibility into organizational changes, investment priorities, sourcing strategies, program schedules, budget cycles, and other developments affecting the account.
  • Represent FDH at customer locations, industry events, supplier meetings, and other strategic business engagements.

Cross-Functional Account Execution

  • Lead the cross-functional FDH account team and establish clear accountability for commercial, operational, technical, quality, and service commitments.
  • Translate customer strategy and requirements into coordinated actions across Sales, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Finance, and executive leadership.
  • Direct internal account reviews to evaluate performance, advance growth initiatives, resolve execution gaps, and align resources with account priorities.
  • Secure the organizational resources and executive support required to pursue strategic opportunities and fulfill customer commitments.
  • Escalate material commercial, operational, quality, or relationship risks and lead the development of timely resolution plans.
  • Ensure customer commitments, internal action items, and strategic initiatives are supported by clear ownership, milestones, and performance expectations.

Commercial Strategy and Financial Performance

  • Own the account’s revenue, gross margin, profitability, pipeline, backlog, and forecast performance.
  • Develop and execute pricing, negotiation, and contract-renewal strategies that support profitable growth and protect FDH’s commercial position.
  • Evaluate business opportunities based on strategic value, revenue potential, margin contribution, operational requirements, contractual exposure, and execution risk.
  • Identify and address margin erosion, pricing pressure, unfavorable commercial terms, and underperforming business.
  • Develop accurate revenue and demand forecasts using customer intelligence, program schedules, backlog, pipeline activity, and market conditions.
  • Establish commercial strategies for major sourcing events, requests for quotation, contract negotiations, and competitive pursuits.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account, pipeline, forecast, and opportunity information within the company’s CRM and reporting systems.

Business Retention and Competitive Strategy

  • Protect the account’s existing business through proactive relationship management, performance oversight, and competitive positioning.
  • Identify emerging risks related to competitor activity, customer sourcing initiatives, supplier changes, pricing, quality, delivery, contract renewals, and product displacement.
  • Develop and execute account-defense strategies before existing business becomes subject to competitive sourcing or performance-related risk.
  • Monitor competitive activity and develop differentiated strategies based on FDH’s product breadth, supplier relationships, technical capabilities, responsiveness, and supply-chain solutions.
  • Maintain an account risk assessment with defined mitigation actions, accountable owners, and completion timelines.

Strategic Business Reviews and Performance Governance

  • Lead formal Quarterly Business Reviews and other strategic customer reviews focused on performance, growth, risk, and long-term partnership objectives.
  • Present account performance across revenue, growth, delivery, quality, service, open actions, pipeline development, and strategic initiatives.
  • Use business reviews to advance joint priorities, secure alignment on future programs, and identify opportunities for expanded partnership.
  • Establish and monitor corrective actions for performance gaps, customer concerns, and unresolved commitments.
  • Track account performance against established strategic, commercial, and operational objectives and adjust the account plan as required.

Customer and Market Intelligence

  • Develop actionable intelligence regarding customer programs, platforms, technical requirements, sourcing plans, decision processes, and competitive environment.
  • Identify the individuals and functions that influence product specifications, supplier selection, commercial awards, and program decisions.
  • Anticipate future customer requirements and translate those insights into product, supplier, inventory, and commercial strategies for FDH.
  • Communicate relevant customer and market intelligence to internal stakeholders to support investment decisions, resource planning, and opportunity development.
  • Ensure material customer intelligence is documented and incorporated into account planning, forecasting, and business-development activities.

What You Bring (Qualifications & Skills):

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, supply chain, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, business development, or complex solution sales.
  • Aerospace, defense, space, electronics distribution, electronic components, or highly engineered products experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing growth strategies for large, complex, and technically demanding customers.
  • Proven record of expanding revenue, gross margin, share of wallet, and executive-level customer relationships.
  • Experience leading complex opportunity pursuits, commercial negotiations, and multiyear account strategies.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with pricing, profitability, forecasting, backlog, pipeline management, and contract terms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive execution within a matrixed organization.
  • Working knowledge of electronic components, interconnect products, aerospace hardware, or related product categories preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently in support of customer and business requirements.

Special Requirements:

jobs.description:
340B Program ManagerRemote | Full-Time

Who We Are

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

What We Are Looking For

At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:

  • Mission Always: Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
  • Be a Pioneer: Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
  • Do the Right Thing the Right Way: Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
  • Stronger Together: Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

We are also a fast-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.

About the Role

The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

What You'll Do

Program Administration & Compliance

  • Manage and oversee day-to-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
  • Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
  • Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
  • Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.

Audit Readiness & Risk Management

  • Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
  • Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.

Client Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
  • Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
  • Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.

What You Bring

Core Capabilities

  • Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, or other covered entities.
  • Familiarity with 340B third-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
  • Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • You are a compliance-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
  • You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
  • You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
  • You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible PTO
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • 401(k) with match
  • Life and disability coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Mission-driven team
  • WFH stipend

Compensation

The expected base compensation for this role is $80,000-85,000 per year.

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, location, and internal equity.

NuvemRx complies with applicable pay transparency laws. The compensation range listed reflects the expected base salary at the time of posting, and actual compensation may vary.

NuvemRx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Our client, a growing alternative-financing company, is seeking a Director of Strategic Partnerships & Origination to expand its professional referral network and generate lower-middle-market financing opportunities, typically ranging from $1M–$25M. The role offers a competitive base salary and performance-based bonuses, with potential total annual compensation of approximately $400,000–$600,000 for strong performance.

The ideal candidate will have experience in commercial finance, private credit, commercial banking, M&A/advisory, investment banking, ABL, factoring, SBA lending, equipment finance, or a related field, along with established relationships with banks, CPAs, attorneys, investment bankers, M&A advisors, financial advisors, private equity firms, and other referral sources.   • Generate qualified $1M–$25M lower-middle-market financing opportunities through an established network

  • Build new referral channels capable of producing consistent, repeat deal flow.

  • Present the company's alternative-financing solutions to referral partners and prospective borrowers.

  • Manage opportunities from initial introduction and qualification through closing.

  • Work closely with credit, underwriting, and leadership teams to develop appropriate financing solutions.

  • Attend industry events and networking opportunities to expand the company's referral network.

Requirements

  • Proven business development, origination, or relationship-management experience within commercial finance or an adjacent financial-services field.

  • Background in private credit, commercial banking, M&A/advisory, investment banking, ABL, factoring, SBA lending, equipment finance, or a related area.

  • Established network of banks, CPAs, attorneys, investment bankers, M&A advisors, financial advisors, PE firms, or other professional referral partners.

  • Demonstrated success generating repeat business through professional referral relationships.

  • Experience with lower-middle-market transactions, ideally $1M–$25M.

  • Strong understanding of commercial financing and lower-middle-market businesses.

  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Self-motivated and comfortable independently developing and managing a book of business.

  • Champion a customer-focused, performance-driven culture that encourages collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the Strategic Account Management organization.

jobs.excerpt: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH USWe're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others.
jobs.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.
  • Data analytics fundamentals - able to interpret reports, understand data visualizations, and assist with report troubleshooting and configuration.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with SaaS, SmartSimple or similar technology platforms.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk.
  • Exposure to the nonprofit, philanthropic, or grants management sector.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
